verses.en: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
verses.fr: Paroles de Néhémie, fils de Hacalia. Au mois de Kisleu, la vingtième année, comme j''étais à Suse, dans la capitale,
verses.am: የሐካልያ ልጅ የነህምያ ቃል። በሀያኛው ዓመት በካሴሉ ወር እንዲህ ሆነ፤

verses.en: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Hanani, l''un de mes frères, et quelques hommes arrivèrent de Juda. Je les questionnai au sujet des Juifs réchappés qui étaient restés de la captivité, et au sujet de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እኔ በሱሳ ግንብ ሳለሁ፥ ከወንድሞቼ አንዱ አናኒ ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎች ሰዎች ከይሁዳ መጡ፤ እኔም የዳኑትን ከምርኮ የተረፉትን የአይሁድን ነገር የኢየሩሳሌምንም ነገር ጠየቅኋቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
verses.fr: Ils me répondirent: Ceux qui sont restés de la captivité sont là dans la province, au comble du malheur et de l''opprobre; les murailles de Jérusalem sont en ruines, et ses portes sont consumées par le feu.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በዚያ ስፍራ ያሉት ከምርኮ የተረፉት ቅሬታዎች በታላቅ መከራና ስድብ አሉ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምም ቅጥር ፈርሶአል፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል አሉኝ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
verses.fr: Lorsque j''entendis ces choses, je m''assis, je pleurai, et je fus plusieurs jours dans la désolation. Je jeûnai et je priai devant le Dieu des cieux,
verses.am: ይህንም ቃል በሰማሁ ጊዜ ተቀምጬ አለቀስሁ፥ አያሌ ቀንም አዝን ነበር፤ በሰማይም አምላክ ፊት እጾምና እጸልይ ነበር፥

verses.en: And said, I beseech thee, O Lord God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
verses.fr: et je dis: O Eternel, Dieu des cieux, Dieu grand et redoutable, toi qui gardes ton alliance et qui fais miséricorde à ceux qui t''aiment et qui observent tes commandements!
verses.am: እንዲህም አልሁ። አቤቱ የሰማይ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለሚወድዱህና ትእዛዝህን ለሚያደርጉ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥ ታላቅና የተፈራህ አምላክ ሆይ፥

verses.en: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
verses.fr: Que ton oreille soit attentive et que tes yeux soient ouverts: écoute la prière que ton serviteur t''adresse en ce moment, jour et nuit, pour tes serviteurs les enfants d''Israël, en confessant les péchés des enfants d''Israël, nos péchés contre toi; car moi et la maison de mon père, nous avons péché.
verses.am: እኔ ባሪያህ ዛሬ በፊትህ ስለ ባሪያዎችህ ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች ሌሊትና ቀን የምጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ ጆሮህ ያድምጥ፥ ዓይኖችህም ይከፈቱ፤ በአንተ ላይም ያደረግነውን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ኃጢአት እናዘዝልሃለሁ፤ እኔና የአባቴም ቤት በድለናል።

verses.en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
verses.fr: Nous t''avons offensé, et nous n''avons point observé les commandements, les lois et les ordonnances que tu prescrivis à Moïse, ton serviteur.
verses.am: እኛም በአንተ ላይ እጅግ ክፉ ሠርተናል፤ ለባሪያህም ለሙሴ ያዘዝኸውን ትእዛዝና ሥርዓት ሕግም አልጠበቅንም።

verses.en: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de cette parole que tu donnas ordre à Moïse, ton serviteur, de prononcer. Lorsque vous pécherez, je vous disperserai parmi les peuples;
verses.am: አሁንም ብትተላለፉ በአሕዛብ መካከል እበትናችኋለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ ብትመለሱ ግን ትእዛዜንም ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጓትም፥ ከእናንተ ሰዎች እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ ድረስ ምንም ቢበተኑ ከዚያ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ስሜም ይኖርበት ዘንድ ወደ መረጥሁት ስፍራ አመጣቸዋለሁ ብለህ ለባሪያህ ለሙሴ ያዘዝኸውን ቃል እባክህ አስብ።

verses.en: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
verses.fr: mais si vous revenez à moi, et si vous observez mes commandements et les mettez en pratique, alors, quand vous seriez exilés à l''extrémité du ciel, de là je vous rassemblerai et je vous ramènerai dans le lieu que j''ai choisi pour y faire résider mon nom.
verses.am: አሁንም ብትተላለፉ በአሕዛብ መካከል እበትናችኋለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ ብትመለሱ ግን ትእዛዜንም ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጓትም፥ ከእናንተ ሰዎች እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ ድረስ ምንም ቢበተኑ ከዚያ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ስሜም ይኖርበት ዘንድ ወደ መረጥሁት ስፍራ አመጣቸዋለሁ ብለህ ለባሪያህ ለሙሴ ያዘዝኸውን ቃል እባክህ አስብ።

verses.en: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.
verses.fr: Ils sont tes serviteurs et ton peuple, que tu as rachetés par ta grande puissance et par ta main forte.
verses.am: እነዚህም በታላቅ ኃይልህና በብርቱ እጅህ የተቤዠሃቸው ባሪያዎችህና ሕዝብህ ናቸው።

verses.en: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
verses.fr: Ah! Seigneur, que ton oreille soit attentive à la prière de ton serviteur, et à la prière de tes serviteurs qui veulent craindre ton nom! Donne aujourd''hui du succès à ton serviteur, et fais-lui trouver grâce devant cet homme! J''étais alors échanson du roi.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጆሮህ የባሪያህን ጸሎት፥ ስምህንም ይፈሩ ዘንድ የሚወድዱትን፥ የባሪያዎችህን ጸሎት ያድምጥ፤ ዛሬም ለባሪያህ አከናውንለት፥ በዚህም ሰው ፊት ምሕረትን ስጠው። እኔም ለንጉሡ ጠጅ አሳላፊው ነበርሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
verses.fr: Au mois de Nisan, la vingtième année du roi Artaxerxès, comme le vin était devant lui, je pris le vin et je l''offris au roi. Jamais je n''avais paru triste en sa présence.
verses.am: በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ በሀያኛው ዓመት በኒሳን ወር የወይን ጠጅ በፊቱ በነበረ ጊዜ ጠጁን አንሥቼ ለንጉሡ ሰጠሁት። ቀድሞ ግን በፊቱ ያለ ኃዘን እኖር ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
verses.fr: Le roi me dit: Pourquoi as-tu mauvais visage? Tu n''es pourtant pas malade; ce ne peut être qu''un chagrin de coeur. Je fus saisi d''une grande crainte,
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ሳትታመም ፊትህ ለምን አዘነ? ይህ የልብ ኅዘን ነው እንጂ ሌላ ነገር አይደለም አለኝ። እጅግም ብዙ አድርጌ ፈራሁ።

verses.en: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
verses.fr: et je répondis au roi: Que le roi vive éternellement! Comment n''aurais-je pas mauvais visage, lorsque la ville où sont les sépulcres de mes pères est détruite et que ses portes sont consumées par le feu?
verses.am: ንጉሡንም። ንጉሡ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ፤ የአባቶቼ መቃብር ያለባት ከተማ ተፈትታለችና፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት ተቃጥለዋልና ፊቴ ስለ ምን አይዘን? አልሁት።

verses.en: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.fr: Et le roi me dit: Que demandes-tu? Je priai le Dieu des cieux,
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ምን ትለምነኛለህ? አለኝ። እኔም ወደ ሰማይ አምላክ ጸለይሁ።

verses.en: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.
verses.fr: et je répondis au roi: Si le roi le trouve bon, et si ton serviteur lui est agréable, envoie-moi en Juda, vers la ville des sépulcres de mes pères, pour que je la rebâtisse.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም። ንጉሡን ደስ ቢያሰኝህ፥ ባሪያህም በፊትህ ሞገስ ቢያገኝ፥ እሠራው ዘንድ ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ አባቶቼ መቃብር ከተማ ስደደኝ አልሁት።

verses.en: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.fr: Le roi, auprès duquel la reine était assise, me dit alors: Combien ton voyage durera-t-il, et quand seras-tu de retour? Il plut au roi de me laisser partir, et je lui fixai un temps.
verses.am: ንግሥቲቱም በአጠገቡ ተቀምጣ ሳለች ንጉሡ። መንገድህ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ይሆናል? መቼስ ትመለሳለህ? አለኝ። ንጉሡም ይሰድደኝ ዘንድ ደስ አለው፤ እኔም ዘመኑን ቀጠርሁለት።

verses.en: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
verses.fr: Puis je dis au roi: Si le roi le trouve bon, qu''on me donne des lettres pour les gouverneurs de l''autre côté du fleuve, afin qu''ils me laissent passer et entrer en Juda,
verses.am: ንጉሡንም። ንጉሡ ደስ ቢለው፥ እስከ ይሁዳ አገር እንዲያደርሱኝ በወንዝ ማዶ ላሉት ገዦች ደብዳቤ ይሰጠኝ፤

verses.en: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
verses.fr: et une lettre pour Asaph, garde forestier du roi, afin qu''il me fournisse du bois de charpente pour les portes de la citadelle près de la maison, pour la muraille de la ville, et pour la maison que j''occuperai. Le roi me donna ces lettres, car la bonne main de mon Dieu était sur moi.
verses.am: በቤቱም አጠገብ ላለው ለግንብ በሮች፥ ለከተማውም ቅጥር፥ ለምገባበትም ቤት እንጨት እንዲሰጠኝ ለንጉሡ ዱር ጠባቂ ለአሳፍ ደብዳቤ ይሰጠኝ አልሁት። ንጉሡም በእኔ ላይ መልካም እንደ ሆነችው እንደ አምላኬ እጅ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
verses.fr: Je me rendis auprès des gouverneurs de l''autre côté du fleuve, et je leur remis les lettres du roi, qui m''avait fait accompagner par des chefs de l''armée et par des cavaliers.
verses.am: በወንዙም ማዶ ወዳሉት አለቆች መጥቼ የንጉሡን ደብዳቤ ሰጠኋቸው ንጉሡም ከእኔ ጋር የሠራዊቱን አለቆችና ፈረሰኞች ሰደደ።

verses.en: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Sanballat, le Horonite, et Tobija, le serviteur ammonite, l''ayant appris, eurent un grand déplaisir de ce qu''il venait un homme pour chercher le bien des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሖሮናዊውም ሰንባላጥና ባሪያው አሞናዊ ጦብያ ለእስራኤል ልጆች መልካምን ነገር የሚሻ ሰው እንደ መጣ በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ተበሳጩ።

verses.en: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.fr: J''arrivai à Jérusalem, et j''y passai trois jours.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ደረስሁ፥ በዚያም ሦስት ቀን ያህል ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.en: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
verses.fr: Après quoi, je me levai pendant la nuit avec quelques hommes, sans avoir dit à personne ce que mon Dieu m''avait mis au coeur de faire pour Jérusalem. Il n''y avait avec moi d''autre bête de somme que ma propre monture.
verses.am: በሌሊትም ተነሣሁ፥ ከእኔም ጋር አያሌ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለኢየሩሳሌም አደርገው ዘንድ በልቤ ያኖረውን ለማንም አላስታወቅሁም፤ ተቀምጬበት ከነበረው እንስሳ በቀር ከእኔ ጋር ምንም እንስሳ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
verses.fr: Je sortis de nuit par la porte de la vallée, et je me dirigeai contre la source du dragon et vers la porte du fumier, considérant les murailles en ruines de Jérusalem et réfléchissant à ses portes consumées par le feu.
verses.am: በሸለቆውም በር ወጣሁ፥ ወደ ዘንዶውም ምንጭና ወደ ጕድፍ መጣያው በር ሄድሁ፤ የፈረሰውንም የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር፥ በእሳትም የተቃጠሉትን በሮችዋን ተመለከትሁ።

verses.en: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
verses.fr: Je passai près de la porte de la source et de l''étang du roi, et il n''y avait point de place par où pût passer la bête qui était sous moi.
verses.am: ወደ ምንጩም በርና ወደ ንጉሡ መዋኛ አለፍሁ፤ ተቀምጬበትም የነበረው እንስሳ የሚያልፍበት ስፍራ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
verses.fr: Je montai de nuit par le torrent, et je considérai encore la muraille. Puis je rentrai par la porte de la vallée, et je fus ainsi de retour.
verses.am: በሌሊትም በፈፋው በኩል ወጥቼ ቅጥሩን ተመለከትሁ፤ ዘወርም ብዬ በሸለቆው በር ገባሁ፥ እንዲሁም ተመለስሁ።

verses.en: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
verses.fr: Les magistrats ignoraient où j''étais allé, et ce que je faisais. Jusqu''à ce moment, je n''avais rien dit aux Juifs, ni aux sacrificateurs, ni aux grands, ni aux magistrats, ni à aucun de ceux qui s''occupaient des affaires.
verses.am: ሹማምቱ ግን ወዴት እንደ ሄድሁ፥ ምን እንዳደረግሁም አላወቁም ነበር፤ ለአይሁድና ለካህናቱ፥ ለታላላቆችና ለሹማምቱም፥ ሥራም ይሠሩ ለነበሩት ለሌሎች ገና አልተናገርሁም ነበር።

verses.en: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
verses.fr: Je leur dis alors: Vous voyez le malheureux état où nous sommes! Jérusalem est détruite, et ses portes sont consumées par le feu! Venez, rebâtissons la muraille de Jérusalem, et nous ne serons plus dans l''opprobre.
verses.am: እኔም። እኛ ያለንበትን ጕስቍልና ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ፈረሰች፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠሉ ታያላችሁ፤ አሁንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ መሳለቂያ እንዳንሆን ኑና የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር እንሥራ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
verses.fr: Et je leur racontai comment la bonne main de mon Dieu avait été sur moi, et quelles paroles le roi m''avait adressées. Ils dirent: Levons-nous, et bâtissons! Et ils se fortifièrent dans cette bonne résolution.
verses.am: የአምላኬም እጅ በእኔ ላይ መልካም እንደሆነች፥ ንጉሡም የነገረኝን ቃል ነገርኋቸው። እነርሱም። እንነሣና እንሥራ አሉ። እጃቸውንም ለበጎ ሥራ አበረቱ።

verses.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
verses.fr: Sanballat, le Horonite, Tobija, le serviteur ammonite, et Guéschem, l''Arabe, en ayant été informés, se moquèrent de nous et nous méprisèrent. Ils dirent: Que faites-vous là? Vous révoltez-vous contre le roi?
verses.am: ሖሮናዊውም ሰንባላጥ፥ ባሪያውም አሞናዊው ጦብያ፥ ዓረባዊውም ጌሳም በሰሙ ጊዜ በንቀት ሳቁብን፥ ቀላል አድርገውንም። ይህ የምታደርጉት ነገር ምንድር ነው? በውኑ በንጉሡ ላይ ትሸፍቱ ዘንድ ትወድዳላችሁን? አሉ።

verses.en: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et je leur fis cette réponse: Le Dieu des cieux nous donnera le succès. Nous, ses serviteurs, nous nous lèverons et nous bâtirons; mais vous, vous n''avez ni part, ni droit, ni souvenir dans Jérusalem.
verses.am: እኔም መልሼ። የሰማይ አምላክ ያከናውንልናል፥ እኛም ባሪያዎቹ ተነሥተን እንሠራለን፤ እናንተ ግን በኢየሩሳሌም እድል ፈንታና መብት መታሰቢያም የላችሁም አልኋቸው።

verses.en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
verses.fr: Eliaschib, le souverain sacrificateur, se leva avec ses frères, les sacrificateurs, et ils bâtirent la porte des brebis. Ils la consacrèrent et en posèrent les battants; ils la consacrèrent, depuis la tour de Méa jusqu''à la tour de Hananeel.
verses.am: ታላቁም ካህን ኤልያሴብ ወንድሞቹም ካህናት ተነሥተው የበግ በር ሠሩ፤ ቀደሱትም፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፤ እስከ ሃሜአ ግንብና እስከ ሐናንኤል ግንብ ድረስ ቀደሱት።

verses.en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
verses.fr: A côté d''Eliaschib bâtirent les hommes de Jéricho; à côté de lui bâtit aussi Zaccur, fils d''Imri.
verses.am: በአጠገቡ የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች ሠሩ፤ በአጠገባቸውም የአምሪ ልጅ ዘኩር ሠራ።

verses.en: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.fr: Les fils de Senaa bâtirent la porte des poissons. Ils la couvrirent, et en posèrent les battants, les verrous et les barres.
verses.am: የሃስናአ ልጆችም የዓሣ በር ሠሩ፤ ሰረገሎቹን አኖሩ፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
verses.fr: A côté d''eux travailla aux réparations Merémoth, fils d''Urie, fils d''Hakkots; à côté d''eux travailla Meschullam, fils de Bérékia, fils de Meschézabeel; à côté d''eux travailla Tsadok, fils de Baana;
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም የአቆስ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት አደሰ። በአጠገባቸውም የሜሴዜቤል ልጅ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አደሰ። በአጠገባቸውም የበዓና ልጅ ሳዶቅ አደሰ።

verses.en: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
verses.fr: côté d''eux travaillèrent les Tekoïtes, dont les principaux ne se soumirent pas au service de leur seigneur.
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም ቴቁሐውያን አደሱ፤ ታላላቆቻቸው ግን ለጌታቸው ሥራ አንገታቸውን አላዋረዱም።

verses.en: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.fr: Jojada, fils de Paséach, et Meschullam, fils de Besodia, réparèrent la vieille porte. Ils la couvrirent, et en posèrent les battants, les verrous et les barres.
verses.am: የፋሴሐ ልጅ ዮዳሄና የበሶድያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አሮጌውን በር አደሱ፤ ሰረገሎቹን አኖሩ፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
verses.fr: A côté d''eux travaillèrent Melatia, le Gabaonite, Jadon, le Méronothite, et les hommes de Gabaon et de Mitspa, ressortissant au siège du gouverneur de ce côté du fleuve;
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም ገባዖናዊው መልጥያና ሜሮኖታዊው ያዶን፥ የወንዙም ማዶ አለቃ ግዛት የሆኑ የገባዖንና የምጽጳ ሰዎች አደሱ።

verses.en: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
verses.fr: côté d''eux travailla Uzziel, fils de Harhaja, d''entre les orfèvres, et à côté de lui travailla Hanania, d''entre les parfumeurs. Ils laissèrent Jérusalem jusqu''à la muraille large.
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም ወርቅ አንጥረኛው የሐርሃያ ልጅ ዑዝኤል አደሰ። በአጠገቡም ከሽቱ ቀማሚዎች የነበረ ሐናንያ አደሰ፤ እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌምን ጠገኑ።

verses.en: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: A côté d''eux travailla aux réparations Rephaja, fils de Hur, chef de la moitié du district de Jérusalem.
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም የኢየሩሳሌም ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ የሆር ልጅ ረፋያ አደሰ።

verses.en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
verses.fr: A côté d''eux travailla vis-à-vis de sa maison Jedaja, fils de Harumaph, et à côté de lui travailla Hattusch, fils de Haschabnia.
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም የኤርማፍ ልጅ ይዳያ በቤቱ አንጻር ያለውን አደሰ። በአጠገቡም የአሰበንያ ልጅ ሐጡስ አደሰ።

verses.en: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
verses.fr: Une autre portion de la muraille et la tour des fours furent réparées par Malkija, fils de Harim, et par Haschub, fils de Pachath-Moab.
verses.am: የካሪም ልጅ መልክያ፥ የፈሐት ሞዓብ ልጅም አሱብ ሌላውን ክፍልና የእቶኑን ግንብ አደሱ።

verses.en: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
verses.fr: A côté d''eux travailla, avec ses filles, Schallum, fils d''Hallochesch, chef de la moitié du district de Jérusalem.
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም የኢየሩሳሌም ግዛት እኵሌታና የመንደሮችዋ አለቃ የአሎኤስ ልጅ ሰሎም አደሰ።

verses.en: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
verses.fr: Hanun et les habitants de Zanoach réparèrent la porte de la vallée. Ils la bâtirent, et en posèrent les battants, les verrous et les barres. Ils firent de plus mille coudées de mur jusqu''à la porte du fumier.
verses.am: ሐኖንና የዛኖዋ ሰዎችም የሸለቆውን በር አደሱ፤ ሠሩት፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ፤ ደግሞም እስከ ጕድፍ መጣያው በር ድረስ አንድ ሺህ ክንድ የሚሆን ቅጥር ሠሩ።

verses.en: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Bethhaccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.fr: Malkija, fils de Récab, chef du district de Beth-Hakkérem, répara la porte du fumier. Il la bâtit, et en posa les battants, les verrous et les barres.
verses.am: የቤትሐካሪምም ግዛት አለቃ የሬካብ ልጅ መልክያ የጕድፍ መጣያውን በር አደሰ፤ ሠራው፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆመ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረገ።

verses.en: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.fr: Schallum, fils de Col-Hozé, chef du district de Mitspa, répara la porte de la source. Il la bâtit, la couvrit, et en posa les battants, les verrous et les barres. Il fit de plus le mur de l''étang de Siloé, près du jardin du roi, jusqu''aux degrés qui descendent de la cité de David.
verses.am: የምጽጳም ግዛት አለቃ የኮልሖዜ ልጅ ሰሎም የምንጩን በር አደሰ፤ ሠራው፥ ከደነውም፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆመ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረገ፤ ከዳዊትም ከተማ እስከሚወርደው ደረጃ ድረስ በንጉሡ አትክልት አጠገብ ያለውን የሼላን መዋኛ ቅጥር ሠራ።

verses.en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
verses.fr: Après lui Néhémie, fils d''Azbuk, chef de la moitié du district de Beth-Tsur, travailla aux réparations jusque vis-à-vis des sépulcres de David, jusqu''à l''étang qui avait été construit, et jusqu''à la maison des héros.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቤትጹር ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ የዓዝቡቅ ልጅ ነህምያ በዳዊት መቃብር አንጻር እስካለው ስፍራ፥ እስከ ተሠራውም መዋኛ፥ እስከ ኃያላኑም ቤት ድረስ አደሰ።

verses.en: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
verses.fr: Après lui travaillèrent les Lévites, Rehum, fils de Bani, et à côté de lui travailla pour son district Haschabia, chef de la moitié du district de Keïla.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ሌዋውያንና የባኒ ልጅ ሬሁም አደሱ። በአጠገባቸውም የቅዒላ ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ ሐሸብያ ስለ ግዛቱ አደሰ።

verses.en: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
verses.fr: Après lui travaillèrent leurs frères, Bavvaï, fils de Hénadad, chef de la moitié du district de Keïla;
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቅዒላ ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ የኤንሐዳድ ልጅ በዋይ ወንድሞቹም አደሱ።

verses.en: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
verses.fr: et à côté de lui Ezer, fils de Josué, chef de Mitspa, répara une autre portion de la muraille, vis-à-vis de la montée de l''arsenal, à l''angle.
verses.am: በአጠገቡም የምጽጳ አለቃ የኢያሱ ልጅ ኤጽር በማዕዘኑ አጠገብ በጦር መሣሪያ ቤት አንጻር ሌላውን ክፍል አደሰ።

verses.en: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.fr: Après lui Baruc, fils de Zabbaï, répara avec ardeur une autre portion, depuis l''angle jusqu''à la porte de la maison d''Eliaschib, le souverain sacrificateur.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የዘባይ ልጅ ባሮክ ከማዕዘኑ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ካህን እስከ ኤልያሴብ ቤት መግቢያ ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል ተግቶ አደሰ።

verses.en: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.fr: Après lui Merémoth, fils d''Urie, fils d''Hakkots, répara une autre portion depuis la porte de la maison d''Eliaschib jusqu''à l''extrémité de la maison d''Eliaschib.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የአቆስ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት ከኤልያሴብ ቤት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ኤልያሴብ ቤት መጨረሻ ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል አደሰ።

verses.en: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
verses.fr: Après lui travaillèrent les sacrificateurs des environs de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቈላው ሰዎች ካህናቱ አደሱ።

verses.en: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
verses.fr: Après eux Benjamin et Haschub travaillèrent vis-à-vis de leur maison. Après eux Azaria, fils de Maaséja, fils d''Anania, travailla à côté de sa maison.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ ብንያምና አሱብ በቤታቸው አንጻር ያለውን አደሱ። ከእነርሱም በኋላ የሐናንያ ልጅ የመዕሤያ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ በቤቱ አጠገብ ያለውን አደሰ።

verses.en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
verses.fr: Après lui Binnuï, fils de Hénadad, répara une autre portion, depuis la maison d''Azaria jusqu''à l''angle et jusqu''au coin.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የኤንሐደድ ልጅ ቢንዊ ከዓዛርያስ ቤት ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል አደሰ።

verses.en: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
verses.fr: Palal, fils d''Uzaï, travailla vis-à-vis de l''angle et de la tour supérieure qui fait saillie en avant de la maison du roi près de la cour de la prison. Après lui travailla Pedaja, fils de Pareosch.
verses.am: የኡዛይ ልጅ ፋላል በማዕዘኑ አንጻር ያለውንና በዘበኞች አደባባይ አጠገብ ከላይኛው የንጉሡ ቤት ወጥቶ የቆመውን ግንብ ሠራ። ከእርሱም በኋላ የፋሮስ ልጅ ፈዳያ ሠራ።

verses.en: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.
verses.fr: Les Néthiniens demeurant sur la colline travaillèrent jusque vis-à-vis de la porte des eaux, à l''orient, et de la tour en saillie.
verses.am: ናታኒምም በዖፌል በውኃው በር አንጻር በምሥራቅ በኩል ወጥቶ በቆመው ግንብ አጠገብ እስካለው ስፍራ ድረስ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
verses.fr: Après eux les Tekoïtes réparèrent une autre portion, vis-à-vis de la grande tour en saillie jusqu''au mur de la colline.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ቴቁሐውያን ወጥቶ በቆመው በታላቁ ግንብ አንጻር ያለውን እስከ ዖፌል ቅጥር ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል አደሱ።

verses.en: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
verses.fr: Au-dessus de la porte des chevaux, les sacrificateurs travaillèrent chacun devant sa maison.
verses.am: ከፈረሱ በር በላይ ካህናቱ እያንዳንዳቸው በየቤታቸው አንጻር አደሱ።

verses.en: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
verses.fr: Après eux Tsadok, fils d''Immer, travailla devant sa maison. Après lui travailla Schemaeja, fils de Schecania, gardien de la porte de l''orient.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ የኢሜር ልጅ ሳዶቅ በቤቱ አንጻር አደሰ። ከእርሱም በኋላ የምሥራቁን በር ጠባቂ የሴኬንያ ልጅ ሸማያ አደሰ።

verses.en: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
verses.fr: Après eux Hanania, fils de Schélémia, et Hanun, le sixième fils de Tsalaph, réparèrent une autre portion de la muraille. Après eux Meschullam, fils de Bérékia, travailla vis-à-vis de sa chambre.
verses.am: ከእርሱ በኋላ የሰሌምያ ልጅ ሐናንያና የሴሌፍ ስድስተኛው ልጁ ሐኖን ሌላውን ክፍል አደሱ። ከዚያም በኋላ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም በጓዳው አንጻር ያለውን አደሰ።

verses.en: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
verses.fr: Après lui Malkija, d''entre les orfèvres, travailla jusqu''aux maisons des Néthiniens et des marchands, vis-à-vis de la porte de Miphkad, et jusqu''à la chambre haute du coin.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ከወርቅ አንጥረኞቹ የነበረ መልክያ እስከ ናታኒምና እስከ ነጋዴዎቹ ቤት ድረስ በሐሚፍቃድ በር አንጻር ያለውን እስከ ማዕዘኑ መውጫ ድረስ አደሰ።

verses.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
verses.fr: Les orfèvres et les marchands travaillèrent entre la chambre haute du coin et la porte des brebis.
verses.am: ከማዕዘኑም መውጫ ጀምረው እስከ በጉ በር ድረስ ወርቅ አንጥረኞችና ነጋዴዎች አደሱ።

verses.en: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
verses.fr: Lorsque Sanballat apprit que nous rebâtissions la muraille, il fut en colère et très irrité. Il se moqua des Juifs,
verses.am: ሰንባላጥም ቅጥሩን እንደ ሠራን በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ ተበሳጨም፥ በአይሁድም አላገጠ።

verses.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
verses.fr: et dit devant ses frères et devant les soldats de Samarie: A quoi travaillent ces Juifs impuissants? Les laissera-t-on faire? Sacrifieront-ils? Vont-ils achever? Redonneront-ils vie à des pierres ensevelies sous des monceaux de poussière et consumées par le feu?
verses.am: በወንድሞቹና በሰማርያ ሠራዊትም ፊት። እነዚህ ደካሞች አይሁድ የሚሠሩት ምንድር ነው? ይተዉላቸዋልን? ይሠዋሉን? በአንድ ቀንስ ይጨርሳሉን? የተቃጠለውንስ ድንጋይ ከፍርስራሹ መልሰው ያድኑታልን? ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
verses.fr: Tobija, l''Ammonite, était à côté de lui, et il dit: Qu''ils bâtissent seulement! Si un renard s''élance, il renversera leur muraille de pierres!
verses.am: አሞናዊውም ጦብያ በአጠገቡ ቆሞ። በድንጋይ በሚሠሩት ቅጥራቸው ላይ ቀበሮ ቢመጣበት ያፈርሰዋል አለ።

verses.en: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
verses.fr: Ecoute, ô notre Dieu, comme nous sommes méprisés! Fais retomber leurs insultes sur leur tête, et livre-les au pillage sur une terre où ils soient captifs.
verses.am: አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ተንቀናልና ስማ፤ ስድባቸውን በራሳቸው ላይ መልስባቸው፤ በምርኮ አገር ለብዝበዛ አሳልፈህ ስጣቸው።

verses.en: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
verses.fr: Ne pardonne pas leur iniquité, et que leur péché ne soit pas effacé de devant toi; car ils ont offensé ceux qui bâtissent.
verses.am: በደላቸውንም አትክደን፥ ኃጢአታቸውም ከፊትህ አይደምሰስ፤ በሠራተኞች ፊት አስቆጥተውሃልና።

verses.en: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.fr: Nous rebâtîmes la muraille, qui fut partout achevée jusqu''à la moitié de sa hauteur. Et le peuple prit à coeur ce travail.
verses.am: ቅጥሩንም ሠራን፤ ቅጥሩም ሁሉ እስከ እኵሌታው ድረስ ተጋጠመ፤ የሕዝቡም ልብ ለሥራው ጨከነ።

verses.en: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
verses.fr: Mais Sanballat, Tobija, les Arabes, les Ammonites et les Asdodiens, furent très irrités en apprenant que la réparation des murs avançait et que les brèches commençaient à se fermer.
verses.am: ሰንባላጥና ጦብያም ዓረባውያንም አሞናውያንም አሽዶዳውያንም የኢየሩሳሌም ቅጥር እየታደሰ እንደ ሄደ፥ የፈረሰውም ሊጠገን እንደ ተጀመረ በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጡ።

verses.en: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
verses.fr: Ils se liguèrent tous ensemble pour venir attaquer Jérusalem et lui causer du dommage.
verses.am: መጥተውም ኢየሩሳሌምን ይወጉና ያሸብሩ ዘንድ ሁሉም በአንድነት ተማማሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.fr: Nous priâmes notre Dieu, et nous établîmes une garde jour et nuit pour nous défendre contre leurs attaques.
verses.am: ወደ አምላካችንም ጸለይን፥ ከእነርሱም የተነሣ በአንጻራቸው ተጠባባቂዎች በሌሊትና በቀን አደረግን።

verses.en: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
verses.fr: Cependant Juda disait: Les forces manquent à ceux qui portent les fardeaux, et les décombres sont considérables; nous ne pourrons pas bâtir la muraille.
verses.am: ይሁዳም። የተሸካሚዎች ኃይል ደከመ፥ ፍርስራሹም ብዙ ነው፤ ቅጥሩንም እንሠራ ዘንድ አንችልም አሉ።

verses.en: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.fr: Et nos ennemis disaient: Ils ne sauront et ne verront rien jusqu''à ce que nous arrivions au milieu d''eux; nous les tuerons, et nous ferons ainsi cesser l''ouvrage.
verses.am: ጠላቶቻችንም። ወደ መካከላቸው እስክንመጣና እስክንገድላቸው ድረስ ሥራቸውንም እስክናስተጓጕል ድረስ አያውቁምና አያዩም አሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you.
verses.fr: Or les Juifs qui habitaient près d''eux vinrent dix fois nous avertir, de tous les lieux d''où ils se rendaient vers nous.
verses.am: በአጠገባቸውም የተቀመጡት አይሁድ መጥተው። ከስፍራው ሁሉ ይመጡብናል ብለው አሥር ጊዜ ነገሩን።

verses.en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je plaçai, dans les enfoncements derrière la muraille et sur des terrains secs, le peuple par familles, tous avec leurs épées, leurs lances et leurs arcs.
verses.am: ከቅጥሩም በስተ ኋላ በኩል ባለው በታችኛው ስፍራ ሰይፋቸውን ጦራቸውንም ቀስታቸውንም አስይዤ ሕዝቡን በየወገናቸው አቆምኋቸው።

verses.en: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verses.fr: Je regardai, et m''étant levé, je dis aux grands, aux magistrats, et au reste du peuple: Ne les craignez pas! Souvenez-vous du Seigneur, grand et redoutable, et combattez pour vos frères, pour vos fils et vos filles, pour vos femmes et pour vos maisons!
verses.am: አይቼም ተነሣሁ፥ ታላላቆቹንና ሹማምቱንም የቀሩትንም ሕዝብ። አትፍሩአቸው፤ ታላቁንና የተፈራውን ጌታ አስቡ፥ ስለ ወንድሞቻችሁም ስለ ወንዶችና ስለ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ስለ ሚስቶቻችሁም ስለ ቤቶቻችሁም ተዋጉ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
verses.fr: Lorsque nos ennemis apprirent que nous étions avertis, Dieu anéantit leur projet, et nous retournâmes tous à la muraille, chacun à son ouvrage.
verses.am: ጠላቶቻችንም ይህ ነገር እንደ ደረሰልን፥ እግዚአብሔርም ምክራቸውን ከንቱ እንዳደረገው ሰሙ፤ እኛም ሁላችን ወደ ቅጥሩ እያንዳንዳችን ወደ ሥራችን ተመለስን።

verses.en: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.fr: Depuis ce jour, la moitié de mes serviteurs travaillaient, et l''autre moitié était armée de lances, de boucliers, d''arcs et de cuirasses. Les chefs étaient derrière toute la maison de Juda.
verses.am: ከዚያም ቀን ጀምሮ እኵሌቶቹ ብላቴኖቼ ሥራ ይሠሩ ነበር፥ እኵሌቶቹም ጋሻና ጦር ቀስትና ጥሩርም ይዘው ነበር፤ አለቆቹም ከይሁዳ ቤት ሁሉ በኋላ ይቆሙ ነበር።

verses.en: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
verses.fr: Ceux qui bâtissaient la muraille, et ceux qui portaient ou chargeaient les fardeaux, travaillaient d''une main et tenaient une arme de l''autre;
verses.am: ቅጥሩንም የሚሠሩትና ተሸካሚዎቹ በአንድ እጃቸው ይሠሩ ነበር፥ በአንድ እጃቸውም የጦር መሣሪያቸውን ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.en: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
verses.fr: chacun d''eux, en travaillant, avait son épée ceinte autour des reins. Celui qui sonnait de la trompette se tenait près de moi.
verses.am: አናጢዎቹም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ሰይፉን በወገቡ ታጥቆ ይሠራ ነበር፤ ቀንደ መለከትም የሚነፋ በአጠገቤ ነበረ።

verses.en: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
verses.fr: Je dis aux grands, aux magistrats, et au reste du peuple: L''ouvrage est considérable et étendu, et nous sommes dispersés sur la muraille, éloignés les uns des autres.
verses.am: ታላላቆቹንና ሹማምቱን የቀሩትንም ሕዝብ። ሥራው ታላቅና ሰፊ ነው፥ እኛም በቅጥሩ ላይ ተበታትነናል፥ አንዱም ከሁለተኛው ርቆአል፤

verses.en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
verses.fr: Au son de la trompette, rassemblez-vous auprès de nous, vers le lieu d''où vous l''entendrez; notre Dieu combattra pour nous.
verses.am: የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ ወደምትሰሙበት ስፍራ ወደዚያ ወደ እኛ ተሰብሰቡ፤ አምላካችን ስለ እኛ ይዋጋል አልኋቸው።

verses.en: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que nous poursuivions l''ouvrage, la moitié d''entre nous la lance à la main depuis le lever de l''aurore jusqu''à l''apparition des étoiles.
verses.am: ሥራውንም ሠራን ከማለዳ ወገግታም ጀምሮ ከዋክብት እስኪወጡ ድረስ እኵሌቶቹ ጦር ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
verses.fr: Dans ce même temps, je dis encore au peuple: Que chacun passe la nuit dans Jérusalem avec son serviteur; faisons la garde pendant la nuit, et travaillons pendant le jour.
verses.am: ደግሞም በዚያ ጊዜ ሕዝቡን። ሁላችሁ ከብላቴኖቻችሁ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ እደሩ፤ በሌሊትም ጠባቂዎች ሁኑልን፥ በቀንም ሥሩ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.
verses.fr: Et nous ne quittions point nos vêtements, ni moi, ni mes frères, ni mes serviteurs, ni les hommes de garde qui me suivaient; chacun n''avait que ses armes et de l''eau.
verses.am: እኔና ወንድሞቼም ብላቴኖቼም በኋላዬም የነበሩት ጠባቂዎች ልብሳችንን አናወልቅም ነበር።

verses.en: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
verses.fr: Il s''éleva de la part des gens du peuple et de leurs femmes de grandes plaintes contre leurs frères les Juifs.
verses.am: በወንድሞቻቸውም በአይሁድ ላይ ትልቅ የሕዝቡና የሚስቶቻቸው ጩኸት ሆነ።

verses.en: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
verses.fr: Les uns disaient: Nous, nos fils et nos filles, nous sommes nombreux; qu''on nous donne du blé, afin que nous mangions et que nous vivions.
verses.am: አያሌዎቹም። ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችን ብዙዎች ናቸው፤ በልተንም በሕይወት እንድንኖር እህልን እንሸምት ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
verses.fr: D''autres disaient: Nous engageons nos champs, nos vignes, et nos maisons, pour avoir du blé pendant la famine.
verses.am: አያሌዎቹም። ከራብ የተነሣ እህልን እንሸምት ዘንድ እርሻችንና ወይናችንን ቤታችንንም አስይዘናል ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
verses.fr: D''autres disaient: Nous avons emprunté de l''argent sur nos champs et nos vignes pour le tribut du roi.
verses.am: ሌሎቹም። ለንጉሡ ግብር እርሻችንንና ወይናችንን አስይዘን ገንዘብ ተበድረናል፤

verses.en: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
verses.fr: Et pourtant notre chair est comme la chair de nos frères, nos enfants sont comme leurs enfants; et voici, nous soumettons à la servitude nos fils et nos filles, et plusieurs de nos filles y sont déjà réduites; nous sommes sans force, et nos champs et nos vignes sont à d''autres.
verses.am: አሁንም ሥጋችን እንደ ወንድሞቻችን ሥጋ፥ ልጆቻችንም እንደ ልጆቻቸው ናቸው፤ እነሆም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችን ባሪያዎች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰጥተናል፥ ከሴቶችም ልጆቻችን ባሪያዎች ሆነው የሚኖሩ አሉ፤ ታላላቆችም እርሻችንና ወይናችንን ይዘዋልና ልናድናቸው አንችልም ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
verses.fr: Je fus très irrité lorsque j''entendis leurs plaintes et ces paroles-là.
verses.am: እኔም ጩኸታቸውንና ይህን ቃል በሰማሁ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣሁ።

verses.en: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
verses.fr: Je résolus de faire des réprimandes aux grands et aux magistrats, et je leur dis: Quoi! vous prêtez à intérêt à vos frères! Et je rassemblai autour d''eux une grande foule,
verses.am: በልቤም አሰብሁ፥ ታላላቆቹንና ሹማምቱንም። ሁላችሁ እያንዳንዳችሁ ወለድ ትወስዳላችሁ ብዬ ተጣላኋቸው፤ ትልቅም ጉባኤ ሰበሰብሁባቸው።

verses.en: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.
verses.fr: et je leur dis: Nous avons racheté selon notre pouvoir nos frères les Juifs vendus aux nations; et vous vendriez vous-mêmes vos frères, et c''est à nous qu''ils seraient vendus! Ils se turent, ne trouvant rien à répondre.
verses.am: እኔም። ለአሕዛብ የተሸጡትን ወንድሞቻችንን አይሁድን በፈቃዳችን ተቤዠን፤ እናንተስ ወንድሞቻችሁን ትሸጣላችሁን? እነርሱስ ለእኛ የተሸጡ ይሆናሉን? አልኋቸው። እነርሱም ዝም አሉ፥ መልስም አላገኙም።

verses.en: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
verses.fr: Puis je dis: Ce que vous faites n''est pas bien. Ne devriez-vous pas marcher dans la crainte de notre Dieu, pour n''être pas insultés par les nations nos ennemies?
verses.am: ደግሞም አልሁ። የምታደርጉት ነገር መልካም አይደለም፤ ጠላቶቻችን አሕዛብ እንዳይሰድቡን አምላካችንን በመፍራት ትሄዱ ዘንድ አይገባችሁምን?

verses.en: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
verses.fr: Moi aussi, et mes frères et mes serviteurs, nous leur avons prêté de l''argent et du blé. Abandonnons ce qu''ils nous doivent!
verses.am: እኔም ደግሞ ወንድሞቼም ብላቴኖቼም ገንዘብና እህል ለእነርሱ አበድረናል፤ እባካችሁ፥ ይህን ወለድ እንተውላቸው።

verses.en: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
verses.fr: Rendez-leur donc aujourd''hui leurs champs, leurs vignes, leurs oliviers et leurs maisons, et le centième de l''argent, du blé, du moût et de l''huile que vous avez exigé d''eux comme intérêt.
verses.am: እርሻቸውንና ወይናቸውን ወይራቸውንና ቤታቸውንም ከእነርሱም የወሰዳችሁትን ገንዘቡንና እህሉን፥ ወይን ጠጁንና ዘይቱን ከመቶ እጅ አንድ እጅ እባካችሁ ዛሬ መልሱላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Nous les rendrons, et nous ne leur demanderons rien, nous ferons ce que tu dis. Alors j''appelai les sacrificateurs, devant lesquels je les fis jurer de tenir parole.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እንመልስላቸዋለን፥ ከእነርሱም ምንም አንሻም፤ እንደ ተናገርህ እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን አሉ። ካህናቱንም ጠርቼ እንደዚህ ነገር ያደርጉ ዘንድ አማልኋቸው።

verses.en: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the Lord. And the people did according to this promise.
verses.fr: Et je secouai mon manteau, en disant: Que Dieu secoue de la même manière hors de sa maison et de ses biens tout homme qui n''aura point tenu parole, et qu''ainsi cet homme soit secoué et laissé à vide! Toute l''assemblée dit: Amen! On célébra l''Eternel. Et le peuple tint parole.
verses.am: ደግሞም ልብሴን አራገፍሁና። ይህን ነገር የማያደርገውን ሰው ከቤቱና ከሥራው እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ያራግፈው፤ እንዲሁም የተራገፈና ባዶ ይሁን አልሁ። ጉባኤውም ሁሉ። አሜን አሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመሰገኑ፤ ሕዝቡም እንደዚህ ነገር አደረጉ።

verses.en: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
verses.fr: Dès le jour où le roi m''établit leur gouverneur dans le pays de Juda, depuis la vingtième année jusqu''à la trente-deuxième année du roi Artaxerxès, pendant douze ans, ni moi ni mes frères n''avons vécu des revenus du gouverneur.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በይሁዳ ምድር ላይ አለቃ እሆን ዘንድ ካዘዘኝ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ከንጉሡ ከአርጤክስስ ከሀያኛው ዓመት እስከ ሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ድረስ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ያህል እኔና ወንድሞቼ ለአለቃ የሚገባውን ስንቅ አልበላንም።

verses.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
verses.fr: Avant moi, les premiers gouverneurs accablaient le peuple, et recevaient de lui du pain et du vin, outre quarante sicles d''argent; leurs serviteurs mêmes opprimaient le peuple. Je n''ai point agi de la sorte, par crainte de Dieu.
verses.am: ከእኔ አስቀድመው የነበሩት አለቆች ግን በሕዝቡ ላይ አክብደው ነበር፤ ስለ እንጀራውና ስለ ወይኑ አርባ ሰቅል ብር ይወስዱ ነበር፤ ሎሌዎቻቸውም ደግሞ በሕዝቡ ላይ ይሠለጥኑ ነበር፤ እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈራሁ እንዲህ አላደረግሁም።

verses.en: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
verses.fr: Bien plus, j''ai travaillé à la réparation de cette muraille, et nous n''avons acheté aucun champ, et mes serviteurs tous ensemble étaient à l''ouvrage.
verses.am: ደግሞም አጥብቄ የቅጥሩን ሥራ ሠራሁ፥ እርሻም አልገዛንም፤ ብላቴኖቼም ሁሉ ወደዚያው ወደ ሥራው ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
verses.fr: J''avais à ma table cent cinquante hommes, Juifs et magistrats, outre ceux qui venaient à nous des nations d''alentour.
verses.am: ደግሞም በዙሪያችን ካሉት አሕዛብ ወደ እኛ ከመጡት ሌላ ከአይሁድና ከሹማምቱ መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች በገበታዬ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
verses.fr: On m''apprêtait chaque jour un boeuf, six moutons choisis, et des oiseaux; et tous les dix jours on préparait en abondance tout le vin nécessaire. Malgré cela, je n''ai point réclamé les revenus du gouverneur, parce que les travaux étaient à la charge de ce peuple.
verses.am: ከወፎችም በቀር ለአንድ ቀን አንድ በሬና ስድስት የሰቡ በጎች፥ በአሥር በአሥር ቀንም ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት ወይን ጠጅ ይዘጋጅልኝ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አገዛዝ በሕዝቡ ላይ ከብዶ ነበርና ለአለቃ የሚገባውን ስንቅ አልሻም ነበር።

verses.en: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi favorablement de moi, ô mon Dieu, à cause de tout ce que j''ai fait pour ce peuple!
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ ለበጎነት አስብልኝ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
verses.fr: Je n''avais pas encore posé les battants des portes, lorsque Sanballat, Tobija, Guéschem, l''Arabe, et nos autres ennemis apprirent que j''avais rebâti la muraille et qu''il n''y restait plus de brèche.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ቅጥሩን እንደ ሠራሁ፥ ከፍራሹም አንዳች እንዳልቀረበት ሰንባላጥና ጦብያ ዓረባዊውም ጌሳም የቀሩትም ጠላቶቻችን ሰሙ፤ ነገር ግን እስከዚያ ጊዜ ድረስ በበሮቹ ውስጥ ሳንቃዎቹን አላቆምሁም ነበር።

verses.en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.fr: Alors Sanballat et Guéschem m''envoyèrent dire: Viens, et ayons ensemble une entrevue dans les villages de la vallée d''Ono. Ils avaient médité de me faire du mal.
verses.am: ሰንባላጥና ጌሳም። መጥተህ በኦኖ ቈላ ውስጥ ባሉት መንደሮች እንገናኝ ብለው ላኩብኝ፤ ነገር ግን ክፉ ያደርጉብኝ ዘንድ ያስቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verses.fr: Je leur envoyai des messagers avec cette réponse: J''ai un grand ouvrage à exécuter, et je ne puis descendre; le travail serait interrompu pendant que je le quitterais pour aller vers vous.
verses.am: እኔም። ትልቅ ሥራ እሠራለሁ፥ እወርድም ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤ ሥራውን ትቼ ወደ እናንተ በመውረዴ ስለ ምን ሥራው ይታጐላል? ብዬ መልእክተኞችን ላክሁባቸው።

verses.en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.fr: Ils m''adressèrent quatre fois la même demande, et je leur fis la même réponse.
verses.am: እንዲህም ቃል አራት ጊዜ ላኩብኝ፤ እኔም እንደ ፊተኛው ቃል መለስሁላቸው።

verses.en: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
verses.fr: Sanballat m''envoya ce message une cinquième fois par son serviteur, qui tenait à la main une lettre ouverte.
verses.am: ሰንባላጥም እንደ ፊተኛው ጊዜ ብላቴናውን አምስተኛ ጊዜ ላከብኝ፤

verses.en: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.
verses.fr: Il y était écrit: Le bruit se répand parmi les nations et Gaschmu affirme que toi et les Juifs vous pensez à vous révolter, et que c''est dans ce but que tu rebâtis la muraille. Tu vas, dit-on, devenir leur roi,
verses.am: በእጁም ውስጥ። አንተና አይሁድ ዓመፅ እንድታስቡ፥ ስለዚህም ቅጥሩን እንድትሠራ፥ ንጉሣቸውም ትሆን ዘንድ እንድትወድድ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
verses.fr: tu as même établi des prophètes pour te proclamer à Jérusalem roi de Juda. Et maintenant ces choses arriveront à la connaissance du roi. Viens donc, et consultons-nous ensemble.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ንጉሥ በይሁዳ አለ ብለው ስለ አንተ በኢየሩሳሌም ይናገሩ ዘንድ ነቢያትን አቁመሃል፤ አሁንም ለንጉሡ ይህን ቃል ያወሩለታል፤ እንግዲህ መጥተህ በአንድነት እንማከር የሚል ክፍት ደብዳቤ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
verses.fr: Je fis répondre à Sanballat: Ce que tu dis là n''est pas; c''est toi qui l''inventes!
verses.am: እኔም። አንተ ከልብህ ፈጥረኸዋል እንጂ እንደ ተናገርኸው ነገር ምንም የለም ብዬ ላክሁበት።

verses.en: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.
verses.fr: Tous ces gens voulaient nous effrayer, et ils se disaient: Ils perdront courage, et l''oeuvre ne se fera pas. Maintenant, ô Dieu, fortifie-moi!
verses.am: እነርሱም ሁሉ ሥራው እንዳይፈጸም። እጃቸው ይደክማል ብለው ያስፈራሩን ዘንድ ወደዱ፤ አሁንም፥ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እጄን አበርታ።

verses.en: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
verses.fr: Je me rendis chez Schemaeja, fils de Delaja, fils de Mehétabeel. Il s''était enfermé, et il dit: Allons ensemble dans la maison de Dieu, au milieu du temple, et fermons les portes du temple; car ils viennent pour te tuer, et c''est pendant la nuit qu''ils viendront pour te tuer.
verses.am: እኔም ወደ መሔጣብኤል ልጅ ወደ ድላያ ልጅ ወደ ሸማያ ቤት ገባሁ፤ እርሱም ተዘግቶ ነበርና። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በመቅደሱ ውስጥ እንገናኝ የመቅደሱንም ደጆች እንዝጋ፤ እነርሱ መጥተው ይገድሉሃልና፥ በሌሊትም ይገድሉህ ዘንድ ይመጣሉና አለ።

verses.en: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
verses.fr: Je répondis: Un homme comme moi prendre la fuite! Et quel homme tel que moi pourrait entrer dans le temple et vivre? Je n''entrerai point.
verses.am: እኔም። እንደ እኔ ያለ ሰው የሸሸና፥ ነፍሱንስ ያድን ዘንድ ወደ መቅደስ የገባ ማን ነው? እኔስ አልገባም አልሁት።

verses.en: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.fr: Et je reconnus que ce n''était pas Dieu qui l''envoyait. Mais il prophétisa ainsi sur moi parce que Sanballat et Tobija lui avaient donné de l''argent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ልኮት እንዳልነበረ፥ በእኔ ላይ ግን ትንቢት እንደ ተናገረ፥ እነሆ፥ አወቅሁ፤ ጦብያና ሰንባላጥም ገዝተውት ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
verses.fr: En le gagnant ainsi, ils espéraient que j''aurais peur, et que je suivrais ses avis et commettrais un péché; et ils auraient profité de cette atteinte à ma réputation pour me couvrir d''opprobre.
verses.am: ይህንም ነገር አደርግና እበድል ዘንድ፥ በእኔም ላይ ክፋት እንዲናገሩና እንዲያላግጡ ያስፈራራኝ ዘንድ ተገዝቶ ነበር።

verses.en: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi, ô mon Dieu, de Tobija et de Sanballat, et de leurs oeuvres! Souviens-toi aussi de Noadia, la prophétesse, et des autres prophètes qui cherchaient à m''effrayer!
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ሥራቸው ጦብያንና ሰንባላጥን ያስፈራሩኝም ዘንድ የወደዱትን ነቢይቱን ኖዓድያን የቀሩትንም ነቢያት አስብ።

verses.en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.
verses.fr: La muraille fut achevée le vingt-cinquième jour du mois d''Elul, en cinquante-deux jours.
verses.am: ቅጥሩም በኤሉል ወር በሀያ አምስተኛው ቀን በአምሳ ሁለት ቀን ውስጥ ተጨረሰ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
verses.fr: Lorsque tous nos ennemis l''apprirent, toutes les nations qui étaient autour de nous furent dans la crainte; elles éprouvèrent une grande humiliation, et reconnurent que l''oeuvre s''était accomplie par la volonté de notre Dieu.
verses.am: ጠላቶቻችንም ሁሉ ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ በዙሪያችን የነበሩ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ በራሳቸውም አሳብ እጅግ ተዋረዱ፥ ይህም ሥራ በእግዚአብሔር እንደ ተደረገ አወቁ።

verses.en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, il y avait aussi des grands de Juda qui adressaient fréquemment des lettres à Tobija et qui en recevaient de lui.
verses.am: ደግሞም በፊቴ ስለ እርሱ መልካም ይናገሩ ነበር፥ ቃሌንም ያወሩለት ነበር፤ ጦብያም ሊያስፈራራኝ ደብዳቤዎችን ይልክ ነበር።

verses.en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
verses.fr: Car plusieurs en Juda étaient liés à lui par serment, parce qu''il était gendre de Schecania, fils d''Arach, et que son fils Jochanan avait pris la fille de Meschullam, fils de Bérékia.
verses.am: ደግሞም በፊቴ ስለ እርሱ መልካም ይናገሩ ነበር፥ ቃሌንም ያወሩለት ነበር፤ ጦብያም ሊያስፈራራኝ ደብዳቤዎችን ይልክ ነበር።

verses.en: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
verses.fr: Ils disaient même du bien de lui en ma présence, et ils lui rapportaient mes paroles. Tobija envoyait des lettres pour m''effrayer.
verses.am: ፤ ደግሞም በፊቴ ስለ እርሱ መልካም ይናገሩ ነበር፥ ቃሌንም ያወሩለት ነበር፤ ጦብያም ሊያስፈራራኝ ደብዳቤዎችን ይልክ ነበር።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.fr: Lorsque la muraille fut rebâtie et que j''eus posé les battants des portes, on établit dans leurs fonctions les portiers, les chantres et les Lévites.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ቅጥሩ ከተሠራ በኋላ፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም ካቆምሁ በኋላ፥ በረኞቹና መዘምራኑ ሌዋውያኑም ከተሾሙ በኋላ፥

verses.en: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.fr: Je donnai mes ordres à Hanani, mon frère, et à Hanania, chef de la citadelle de Jérusalem, homme supérieur au grand nombre par sa fidélité et par sa crainte de Dieu.
verses.am: ወንድሜን አናኒንና የግንቡን አለቃ ሐናንያን በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ሾምኋቸው፤ እርሱም እውነተኛ ከሌሎቹም ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
verses.fr: Je leur dis: Les portes de Jérusalem ne s''ouvriront pas avant que la chaleur du soleil soit venue, et l''on fermera les battants aux verrous en votre présence; les habitants de Jérusalem feront la garde, chacun à son poste devant sa maison.
verses.am: እኔም። ፀሐይ እስኪሞቅ ድረስ የኢየሩሳሌም በሮች አይከፈቱ፤ እነርሱም ቆመው ሳሉ ደጆቹን ይዝጉ፥ ይቈልፉም፤ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ሰዎች አንዳንዱን በየተራው አንዳንዱንም በየቤቱ አንጻር ጠባቆችን አስቀምጡ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
verses.fr: La ville était spacieuse et grande, mais peu peuplée, et les maisons n''étaient pas bâties.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም ሰፊና ታላቅ ነበረች፤ በውስጥዋ የነበሩ ሕዝብ ግን ጥቂቶች ነበሩ፥ ቤቶቹም አልተሠሩም ነበር።

verses.en: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
verses.fr: Mon Dieu me mit au coeur d''assembler les grands, les magistrats et le peuple, pour en faire le dénombrement. Je trouvai un registre généalogique de ceux qui étaient montés les premiers, et j''y vis écrit ce qui suit.
verses.am: አምላኬም ታላቆቹንና ሹማምቱን ሕዝቡንም ሰብስቤ እቈጥራቸው ዘንድ በልቤ አደረገ፤ አስቀድመው የመጡትን ሰዎች የትውልድ መጽሐፋቸውን አገኘሁ፥ በእርሱም እንደዚህ ተጽፎ አገኘሁ።

verses.en: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.fr: Voici ceux de la province qui revinrent de l''exil, ceux que Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, avait emmenés captifs, et qui retournèrent à Jérusalem et en Juda, chacun dans sa ville.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ከማረካቸው ምርኮኞች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምና ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ እየከተማቸው የተመለሱት የአገር ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
verses.fr: Ils partirent avec Zorobabel, Josué, Néhémie, Azaria, Raamia, Nachamani, Mardochée, Bilschan, Mispéreth, Bigvaï, Nehum, Baana. Nombre des hommes du peuple d''Israël:
verses.am: ከዘሩባቤል፥ ከኢያሱ፥ ከነህምያ፥ ከአዛርያስ፥ ከረዓምያ፥ ከነሐማኒ፥ ከመርዶክዮስ፥ ከበላሳን፥ ከሚስጴሬት፥ ከበጉዋይ፥ ከነሑም፥ ከበዓና ጋር መጡ።

verses.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.fr: les fils de Pareosch, deux mille cent soixante-douze;
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሕዝብ ሰዎች ቍጥር ይህ ነው፤ የፋሮስ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.fr: les fils de Schephathia, trois cent soixante-douze;
verses.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.fr: les fils d''Arach, six cent cinquante-deux;
verses.am: የኤራ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
verses.fr: les fils de Pachath-Moab, des fils de Josué et de Joab, deux mille huit cent dix-huit;
verses.am: ከኢያሱና ከኢዮአብ ልጆች የሆኑ የፈሐት ሞዓብ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ ስምንት መቶ አሥራ ስምንት።

verses.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.fr: les fils d''Elam, mille deux cent cinquante-quatre;
verses.am: የኤላም ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ አራት።

verses.en: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Zatthu, huit cent quarante-cinq;
verses.am: የዛቱዕ ልጆች፥ ስምንት መቶ አርባ አምስት።

verses.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.fr: les fils de Zaccaï, sept cent soixante;
verses.am: የዘካይ ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ።

verses.en: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
verses.fr: les fils de Binnuï, six cent quarante-huit;
verses.am: የቢንዊ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አርባ ስምንት።

verses.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
verses.fr: les fils de Bébaï, six cent vingt-huit;
verses.am: የቤባይ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.en: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
verses.fr: les fils d''Azgad, deux mille trois cent vingt-deux;
verses.am: የዓዝጋድ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
verses.fr: les fils d''Adonikam, six cent soixante-sept;
verses.am: የአዶኒቃም ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ስድሳ ሰባት።

verses.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
verses.fr: les fils de Bigvaï, deux mille soixante-sept;
verses.am: የበጉዋይ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ ስድሳ ሰባት።

verses.en: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
verses.fr: les fils d''Adin, six cent cinquante-cinq;
verses.am: የዓዲን ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ አምስት።

verses.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.fr: les fils d''Ather, de la famille d''Ezéchias, quatre-vingt-dix-huit;
verses.am: የሕዝቅያስ ወገን የአጤር ልጆች፥ ዘጠና ስምንት።

verses.en: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
verses.fr: les fils de Haschum, trois cent vingt-huit;
verses.am: የሐሱም ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
verses.fr: les fils de Betsaï, trois cent vingt-quatre;
verses.am: የቤሳይ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ አራት።

verses.en: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.
verses.fr: les fils de Hariph, cent douze;
verses.am: የሐሪፍ ልጆች፥ መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Gabaon, quatre-vingt-quinze;
verses.am: የገባዖን ልጆች፥ ዘጠና አምስት።

verses.en: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.fr: les gens de Bethléhem et de Netopha, cent quatre-vingt-huit;
verses.am: የቤተ ልሔምና የነጦፋ ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሰማንያ ስምንት።

verses.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.fr: les gens d''Anathoth, cent vingt-huit;
verses.am: የዓናቶች ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.en: The men of Bethazmaveth, forty and two.
verses.fr: les gens de Beth-Azmaveth, quarante-deux;
verses.am: የቤትዓዝሞት ሰዎች፥ አርባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The men of Kirjathjearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
verses.fr: les gens de Kirjath-Jearim, de Kephira et de Beéroth, sept cent quarante-trois;
verses.am: የቂርያትይዓሪምና የከፊራ የብኤሮትም ሰዎች፥ ሰባት መቶ አርባ ሦስት።

verses.en: The men of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.fr: les gens de Rama et de Guéba, six cent vingt et un;
verses.am: የራማና የጌባ ሰዎች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ አንድ።

verses.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
verses.fr: les gens de Micmas, cent vingt-deux;
verses.am: የማክማስ ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ሁለት።

verses.en: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
verses.fr: les gens de Béthel et d''Aï, cent vingt-trois;
verses.am: የቤቴልና የጋይ ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።

verses.en: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.fr: les gens de l''autre Nebo, cinquante-deux;
verses.am: የሁለተኛው ናባው ሰዎች፥ አምሳ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.fr: les fils de l''autre Elam, mille deux cent cinquante-quatre;
verses.am: የሁለተኛው ኤላም ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ አራት።

verses.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.fr: les fils de Harim, trois cent vingt;
verses.am: የካሪም ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ።

verses.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Jéricho, trois cent quarante-cinq;
verses.am: የኢያሪኮ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ አርባ አምስት

verses.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
verses.fr: les fils de Lod, de Hadid et d''Ono, sept cent vingt et un;
verses.am: የሎድና የሐዲድ የኦኖም ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ አንድ።

verses.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
verses.fr: les fils de Senaa, trois mille neuf cent trente.
verses.am: የሴናዓ ልጆች፥ ሦስት ሺህ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሠላሳ።

verses.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.fr: Sacrificateurs: les fils de Jedaeja, de la maison de Josué, neuf cent soixante-treize;
verses.am: ካህናቱ፤ ከኢያሱ ወገን የዮዳኤ ልጆች፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሰባ ሦስት።

verses.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.fr: les fils d''Immer, mille cinquante-deux;
verses.am: የኢሜር ልጆች፥ ሺህ አምሳ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.fr: les fils de Paschhur, mille deux cent quarante-sept;
verses.am: የፋስኮር ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አርባ ሰባት።

verses.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.fr: les fils de Harim, mille dix-sept.
verses.am: የካሪም ልጆች፥ ሺህ አሥራ ሰባት።

verses.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
verses.fr: Lévites: les fils de Josué et de Kadmiel, des fils d''Hodva, soixante-quatorze.
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑ፤ ከሆዳይዋ ወገን የኢያሱና የቀድምኤል ልጆች፥ ሰባ አራት።

verses.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
verses.fr: Chantres: les fils d''Asaph, cent quarante-huit.
verses.am: መዘምራኑ፤ የአሳፍ ልጆች፥ መቶ አርባ ስምንት።

verses.en: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
verses.fr: Portiers: les fils de Schallum, les fils d''Ather, les fils de Thalmon, les fils d''Akkub, les fils de Hathitha, les fils de Schobaï, cent trente-huit.
verses.am: በረኞቹ፤ የሰሎም ልጆች፥ የአጤር ልጆች፥ የጤልሞን ልጆች፥ የዓቁብ ልጆች፥ የሐጢጣ ልጆች፥ የሶባይ ልጆች፥ መቶ ሠላሳ ስምንት።

verses.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.fr: Néthiniens: les fils de Tsicha, les fils de Hasupha, les fils de Thabbaoth,
verses.am: ናታኒም፥ የሲሐ ልጆች፥ የሐሡፋ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
verses.fr: les fils de Kéros, les fils de Sia, les fils de Padon,
verses.am: የጠብዖት ልጆች፥ የኬራስ ልጆች፥ የሲዓ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,
verses.fr: les fils de Lebana, les fils de Hagaba, les fils de Salmaï,
verses.am: የፋዶን ልጆች፥ የልባና ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
verses.fr: les fils de Hanan, les fils de Guiddel, les fils de Gachar,
verses.am: የአጋባ ልጆች፥ የሰምላይ ልጆች፥ የሐናን ልጆች፥ የጌዴል ልጆች፥ የጋሐር ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
verses.fr: les fils de Reaja, les fils de Retsin, les fils de Nekoda,
verses.am: የራያ ልጆች፥ የረአሶን ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
verses.fr: les fils de Gazzam, les fils d''Uzza, les fils de Paséach,
verses.am: የጋሴም ልጆች፥ የዖዛ ልጆች፥ የፋሴሐ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
verses.fr: les fils de Bésaï, les fils de Mehunim, les fils de Nephischsim,
verses.am: የቤሳይ ልጆች፥ የምዑናውያን ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.fr: les fils de Bakbuk, les fils de Hakupha, les fils de Harhur,
verses.am: የንፉሰሲም ልጆች፥ የበቅቡቅ ልጆች፥ የሐቀፋ ልጆች፥ የሐርሑር ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.fr: les fils de Batslith, les fils de Mehida, les fils de Harscha,
verses.am: የበስሎት ልጆች፥ የምሒዳ ልጆች፥ የሐርሻ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
verses.fr: les fils de Barkos, les fils de Sisera, les fils de Thamach,
verses.am: የበርቆስ ልጆች፥ የሲሣራ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.fr: les fils de Netsiach, les fils de Hathipha.
verses.am: የቴማ ልጆች፥ የንስያ ልጆች፥ የሐጢፋ ልጆች።

verses.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
verses.fr: Fils des serviteurs de Salomon: les fils de Sothaï, les fils de Sophéreth, les fils de Perida,
verses.am: የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ልጆች፤ የሶጣይ ልጆች፥ የሶፌሬት ልጆች፥ የፍሩዳ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.fr: les fils de Jaala, les fils de Darkon, les fils de Guiddel,
verses.am: የየዕላ ልጆች፥ የደርቆን ልጆች፥ የጌዴል ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
verses.fr: les fils de Schephathia, les fils de Hatthil, les fils de Pokéreth-Hatsebaïm, les fils d''Amon.
verses.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ የሐጢል ልጆች፥ የፈከራት ልጆች፥ የሐፂቦይም ልጆች፥ የአሞን ልጆች።

verses.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.fr: Total des Néthiniens et des fils des serviteurs de Salomon: trois cent quatre-vingt-douze.
verses.am: ናታኒም ሁሉና የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
verses.fr: Voici ceux qui partirent de Thel-Mélach, de Thel-Harscha, de Kerub-Addon, et d''Immer, et qui ne purent pas faire connaître leur maison paternelle et leur race, pour prouver qu''ils étaient d''Israël.
verses.am: ከቴልሜላ፥ ከቴላሬሳ፥ ከክሩብ፥ ከአዳን፥ ከኢሜር የወጡ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ነገር ግን የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶችና ዘራቸውን ወይም ከእስራኤል ወገን መሆናቸውን ያስታውቁ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤

verses.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.fr: Les fils de Delaja, les fils de Tobija, les fils de Nekoda, six cent quarante-deux.
verses.am: የዳላያ ልጆች፥ የጦብያ ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አርባ ሁለት።

verses.en: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
verses.fr: Et parmi les sacrificateurs: les fils de Hobaja, les fils d''Hakkots, les fils de Barzillaï, qui avait pris pour femme une des filles de Barzillaï, le Galaadite, et fut appelé de leur nom.
verses.am: ከካህናቱም የኤብያ ልጆች፥ የአቆስ ልጆች፥ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ልጆች ሚስት ያገባ በስሙም የተጠራ የቤርዜሊ ልጆች።

verses.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.fr: Ils cherchèrent leurs titres généalogiques, mais ils ne les trouvèrent point. On les exclut du sacerdoce,
verses.am: እነዚህ በትውልድ መጽሐፍ ትውልዳቸውን ፈለጉ፥ ነገር ግን አልተገኘም፤ ከክህነትም ተከለከሉ።

verses.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.fr: et le gouverneur leur dit de ne pas manger des choses très saintes jusqu''à ce qu''un sacrificateur eût consulté l''urim et le thummim.
verses.am: ሐቴርሰታም። በኡሪምና በቱሚም የሚፈርድ ካህን እስኪነሣ ደረስ ከተቀደሰው ነገር አትበሉም አላቸው።

verses.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.fr: L''assemblée tout entière était de quarante-deux mille trois cent soixante personnes,
verses.am: ፈረሶቻቸውም ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ስድስት፥ በቅሎቻቸውም ሁለት መቶ አርባ አምስት፥

verses.en: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.fr: sans compter leurs serviteurs et leurs servantes, au nombre de sept mille trois cent trente-sept. Parmi eux se trouvaient deux cent quarante-cinq chantres et chanteuses.
verses.am: ፈረሶቻቸውም ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ስድስት፥ በቅሎቻቸውም ሁለት መቶ አርባ አምስት፥

verses.en: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
verses.fr: Ils avaient sept cent trente-six chevaux, deux cent quarante-cinq mulets,
verses.am: ግመሎቻቸውም አራት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት፥ አህዮቻቸውም ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
verses.fr: quatre cent trente-cinq chameaux, et six mille sept cent vingt ânes.
verses.am: ከአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችም አያሌዎቹ ሰዎች ስለ ሥራው ስጦታ ሰጡ። ሐቴርሰታም አንድ ሺህ የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ አምሳም ድስቶች፥ አምስት መቶ ሠላሳም የካህናት ልብስ በቤተ መዛግብት ውስጥ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.
verses.fr: Plusieurs des chefs de famille firent des dons pour l''oeuvre. Le gouverneur donna au trésor mille dariques d''or, cinquante coupes, cinq cent trente tuniques sacerdotales.
verses.am: ከአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችም አያሌዎቹ በሥራው ቤተ መዛግብት ውስጥ ሀያ ሺህ የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶም ምናን ብር ሰጡ።

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
verses.fr: Les chefs de familles donnèrent au trésor de l''oeuvre vingt mille dariques d''or et deux mille deux cents mines d''argent.
verses.am: የቀሩትም ሕዝብ የሰጡት ሀያ ሺህ የወርቅ ዳሪክና ሁለት ሺህ ምናን ብር፥ ስድሳ ሰባትም የካህናት ልብስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
verses.fr: Le reste du peuple donna vingt mille dariques d''or, deux mille mines d''argent, et soixante-sept tuniques sacerdotales.
verses.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹና መዘምራኑም ከሕዝቡም አያሌዎቹ፥ ናታኒምም፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, les portiers, les chantres, les gens du peuple, les Néthiniens et tout Israël s''établirent dans leurs villes. Le septième mois arriva, et les enfants d''Israël étaient dans leurs villes.
verses.am: ፤ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹና መዘምራኑም ከሕዝቡም አያሌዎቹ፥ ናታኒምም፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.
verses.fr: Alors tout le peuple s''assembla comme un seul homme sur la place qui est devant la porte des eaux. Ils dirent à Esdras, le scribe, d''apporter le livre de la loi de Moïse, prescrite par l''Eternel à Israël.
verses.am: ሰባተኛውም ወር በደረሰ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች በከተሞቻቸው ነበሩ። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በውኃው በር ፊት ወዳለው አደባባይ እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለእስራኤል ያዘዘውን የሙሴን ሕግ መጽሐፍ ያመጣ ዘንድ ጸሐፊውን ዕዝራን ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.fr: Et le sacrificateur Esdras apporta la loi devant l''assemblée, composée d''hommes et de femmes et de tous ceux qui étaient capables de l''entendre. C''était le premier jour du septième mois.
verses.am: ካህኑም ዕዝራ በሰባተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ሕጉን በማኅበሩ በወንዶችና በሴቶች አስተውለውም በሚሰሙት ሁሉ ፊት አመጣው።

verses.en: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
verses.fr: Esdras lut dans le livre depuis le matin jusqu''au milieu du jour, sur la place qui est devant la porte des eaux, en présence des hommes et des femmes et de ceux qui étaient capables de l''entendre. Tout le peuple fut attentif à la lecture du livre de la loi.
verses.am: በውኃውም በር ፊት ባለው አደባባይ ላይ ቆሞ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች የሚያስተውሉም ሲሰሙ፥ ከማለዳ ጀምሮ እስከ ቀትር ድረስ አነበበው፤ የሕዝቡም ሁሉ ጆሮ የሕጉን መጽሐፍ ለመስማት ያደምጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.fr: Esdras, le scribe, était placé sur une estrade de bois, dressée à cette occasion. Auprès de lui, à sa droite, se tenaient Matthithia, Schéma, Anaja, Urie, Hilkija et Maaséja, et à sa gauche, Pedaja, Mischaël, Malkija, Haschum, Haschbaddana, Zacharie et Meschullam.
verses.am: ጸሐፊውም ዕዝራ ስለዚህ ነገር በተሠራ በእንጨት መረባርብ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር፤ በአጠገቡ መቲትያ፥ ሽማዕ፥ ዓናያ፥ ኦርዮ፥ ኬልቅያስ፥ መዕሤያ በቀኙ በኩል፥ ፈዳያ፥ ሚሳኤል፥ መልክያ፥ ሐሱም፥ ሐሽበዳና፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ሜሱላም በግራው በኩል ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
verses.fr: Esdras ouvrit le livre à la vue de tout le peuple, car il était élevé au-dessus de tout le peuple; et lorsqu''il l''eut ouvert, tout le peuple se tint en place.
verses.am: ዕዝራም በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ብሎ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እያዩ መጽሐፉን ገለጠ፤ በገለጠውም ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.fr: Esdras bénit l''Eternel, le grand Dieu, et tout le peuple répondit, en levant les mains: Amen! amen! Et ils s''inclinèrent et se prosternèrent devant l''Eternel, le visage contre terre.
verses.am: ዕዝራም ታላቁን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ባረከ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እጃቸውን እየዘረጉ። አሜን፥ አሜን ብለው መለሱ። ራሳቸውንም አዘነበሉ፥ በግምባራቸውም ተደፍተው ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገዱ።

verses.en: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
verses.fr: Josué, Bani, Schérébia, Jamin, Akkub, Schabbethaï, Hodija, Maaséja, Kelitha, Azaria, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaja, et les Lévites, expliquaient la loi au peuple, et chacun restait à sa place.
verses.am: ደግሞ ኢያሱና ባኒ፥ ሰራብያ፥ ያሚን፥ ዓቁብ፥ ሳባታይ፥ ሆዲያ፥ መዕሤያ፥ ቆሊጣስ፥ ዓዛርያስ፥ ዮዛባት፥ ሐናን፥ ፌልያ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ሕጉን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ያስተምሩ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም በየስፍራቸው ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verses.fr: Ils lisaient distinctement dans le livre de la loi de Dieu, et ils en donnaient le sens pour faire comprendre ce qu''ils avaient lu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ሕግ መጽሐፍ አነበቡ፤ ዕዝራም እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ ያስተምርና ያስታውቅ ነበር፥ ሕዝቡም የሚነበበውን ያስተውሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.fr: Néhémie, le gouverneur, Esdras, le sacrificateur et le scribe, et les Lévites qui enseignaient le peuple, dirent à tout le peuple: Ce jour est consacré à l''Eternel, votre Dieu; ne soyez pas dans la désolation et dans les larmes! Car tout le peuple pleurait en entendant les paroles de la loi.
verses.am: ሐቴርሰታ ነህምያም ጸሐፊውም ካህኑ ዕዝራ ሕዝቡንም የሚያስተምሩ ሌዋውያን ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ዛሬ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ቀን ነው፤ አታልቅሱ እንባም አታፍስሱ አሉአቸው፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የሕጉን ቃል በሰሙ ጊዜ ያለቅሱ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.
