verses.fr: Ils leur dirent: Allez, mangez des viandes grasses et buvez des liqueurs douces, et envoyez des portions à ceux qui n''ont rien de préparé, car ce jour est consacré à notre Seigneur; ne vous affligez pas, car la joie de l''Eternel sera votre force.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ የሰባውንም ብሉ፥ ጣፋጩንም ጠጡ፥ ለእነዚያም ላልተዘጋጀላቸው እድል ፈንታቸውን ስደዱ፤ ዛሬ ለጌታችን የተቀደሰ ቀን ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ደስታ ኃይላችሁ ነውና አትዘኑ አላቸው።

verses.en: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
verses.fr: Les Lévites calmaient tout le peuple, en disant: Taisez-vous, car ce jour est saint; ne vous affligez pas!
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም። ቀኑ የተቀደሰ ነውና ዝም በሉ፥ አትዘኑም ብለው ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ጸጥ ያደርጉ ነበር።

verses.en: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
verses.fr: Et tout le peuple s''en alla pour manger et boire, pour envoyer des portions, et pour se livrer à de grandes réjouissances. Car ils avaient compris les paroles qu''on leur avait expliquées.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የተነገረላቸውን ቃል አስተውለዋልና ሊበሉና ሊጠጡ እድል ፈንታም ሊሰድዱ ደስታም ሊያደርጉ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
verses.fr: Le second jour, les chefs de famille de tout le peuple, les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, s''assemblèrent auprès d''Esdras, le scribe, pour entendre l''explication des paroles de la loi.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ካህናቱም ሌዋውያኑም የሕጉን ቃል ይተረጕምላቸው ዘንድ ወደ ጸሐፊው ወደ ዕዝራ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And they found written in the law which the Lord had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
verses.fr: Et ils trouvèrent écrit dans la loi que l''Eternel avait prescrite par Moïse, que les enfants d''Israël devaient habiter sous des tentes pendant la fête du septième mois,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወጥተው አመጡ፤ እያንዳንዱም በቤቱ ሰገነት ላይ፥ በአደባባዩም ላይ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አደባባዩ ላይ፥ በውኃውም በር አደባባይና በኤፍሬም በር አደባባይ ላይ ዳስ ሠራ።

verses.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
verses.fr: et proclamer cette publication dans toutes leurs villes et à Jérusalem: Allez chercher à la montagne des rameaux d''olivier, des rameaux d''olivier sauvage, des rameaux de myrte, des rameaux de palmier, et des rameaux d''arbres touffus, pour faire des tentes, comme il est écrit.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወጥተው አመጡ፤ እያንዳንዱም በቤቱ ሰገነት ላይ፥ በአደባባዩም ላይ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አደባባዩ ላይ፥ በውኃውም በር አደባባይና በኤፍሬም በር አደባባይ ላይ ዳስ ሠራ።

verses.en: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.fr: Alors le peuple alla chercher des rameaux, et ils se firent des tentes sur le toit de leurs maisons, dans leurs cours, dans les parvis de la maison de Dieu, sur la place de la porte des eaux et sur la place de la porte d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: ከምርኮም የተመለሱት ማኅበር ሁሉ ዳስ ሠሩ፥ በዳሱም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ። ከነዌም ልጅ ከኢያሱ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ያለ አላደረጉም ነበር። እጅግም ታላቅ ደስታ ሆነ።

verses.en: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée de ceux qui étaient revenus de la captivité fit des tentes, et ils habitèrent sous ces tentes. Depuis le temps de Josué, fils de Nun, jusqu''à ce jour, les enfants d''Israël n''avaient rien fait de pareil. Et il y eut de très grandes réjouissances.
verses.am: ከመጀመሪያውም ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ መጨረሻው ቀን ድረስ ዕለት ዕለት የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ መጽሐፍ ያነብብ ነበር። በዓሉን ሰባት ቀን ያህል አደረጉ፤ በስምንተኛውም ቀን እንደ ሕጉ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ነበረ።

verses.en: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
verses.fr: On lut dans le livre de la loi de Dieu chaque jour, depuis le premier jour jusqu''au dernier. On célébra la fête pendant sept jours, et il y eut une assemblée solennelle le huitième jour, comme cela est ordonné.
verses.am: ፤ ከመጀመሪያውም ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ መጨረሻው ቀን ድረስ ዕለት ዕለት የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ መጽሐፍ ያነብብ ነበር። በዓሉን ሰባት ቀን ያህል አደረጉ፤ በስምንተኛውም ቀን እንደ ሕጉ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ነበረ።

verses.en: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
verses.fr: Le vingt-quatrième jour du même mois, les enfants d''Israël s''assemblèrent, revêtus de sacs et couverts de poussière, pour la célébration d''un jeûne.
verses.am: በዚህም ወር በሀያ አራተኛው ቀን የእስራኤል ልጆች ጾመው፥ ማቅም ለብሰው፥ በላያቸውም ትቢያ ነስንሰው ተከማቹ።

verses.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient de la race d''Israël, s''étant séparés de tous les étrangers, se présentèrent et confessèrent leurs péchés et les iniquités de leurs pères.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ዘር ከእንግዶች ሁሉ ራሳቸውን ለዩ፥ ቆመውም ኃጢአታቸውንና የአባቶቻቸውን ኃጢአት ተናዘዙ።

verses.en: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the Lord their God.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent placés, on lut dans le livre de la loi de l''Eternel, leur Dieu, pendant un quart de la journée; et pendant un autre quart ils confessèrent leurs péchés et se prosternèrent devant l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: በየስፍራቸውም ቆመው የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን የሕግ መጽሐፍ የቀን ሩብ ያህል አነበቡ፤ ሦስት የቀን ሩብም ያህል ተናዘዙ፥ ለአምላካቸው ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገዱ።

verses.en: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the Lord their God.
verses.fr: Josué, Bani, Kadmiel, Schebania, Bunni, Schérébia, Bani et Kenani montèrent sur l''estrade des Lévites et crièrent à haute voix vers l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም ኢያሱና ባኒ፥ ቀድምኤል፥ ሰበንያ፥ ቡኒ፥ ሰራብያ፥ ባኒ፥ ክናኒ በደረጃዎች ላይ ቆመው ወደ አምላካቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኹ።

verses.en: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the Lord your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.fr: Et les Lévites Josué, Kadmiel, Bani, Haschabnia, Schérébia, Hodija, Schebania et Pethachja, dirent: Levez-vous, bénissez l''Eternel, votre Dieu, d''éternité en éternité! Que l''on bénisse ton nom glorieux, qui est au-dessus de toute bénédiction et de toute louange!
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም ኢያሱ፥ ቀድምኤል፥ ባኒ፥ አሰበንያ፥ ሰራብያ፥ ሆዲያ፥ ሰበንያ፥ ፈታያ እንዲህ አሉ። ቆማችሁ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ። እንዲህም በሉ። በበረከትና በምስጋና ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያለው ክቡር ስምህ ይባረክ።

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art Lord alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
verses.fr: C''est toi, Eternel, toi seul, qui as fait les cieux, les cieux des cieux et toute leur armée, la terre et tout ce qui est sur elle, les mers et tout ce qu''elles renferment. Tu donnes la vie à toutes ces choses, et l''armée des cieux se prosterne devant toi.
verses.am: አንተ ብቻ እግዚአብሔር ነህ፤ ሰማዩንና የሰማያት ሰማይን ሠራዊታቸውንም ሁሉ፥ ምድሩንና በእርስዋ ላይ ያሉትን ሁሉ፥ ባሕሮቹንና በእነርሱ ውስጥ ያለውን ሁሉ፥ ፈጥረሃል፥ ሁሉንም ሕያው አድርገኸዋል፤ የሰማዩም ሠራዊት ለአንተ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: Thou art the Lord the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
verses.fr: C''est toi, Eternel Dieu, qui as choisi Abram, qui l''as fait sortir d''Ur en Chaldée, et qui lui as donné le nom d''Abraham.
verses.am: አንተ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነህ፤ አብራምን መረጥህ፥ ከዑር ከላውዴዎንም አወጣኸው፥ ስሙንም አብርሃም አልኸው፤

verses.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:
verses.fr: Tu trouvas son coeur fidèle devant toi, tu fis alliance avec lui, et tu promis de donner à sa postérité le pays des Cananéens, des Héthiens, des Amoréens, des Phéréziens, des Jébusiens et des Guirgasiens. Et tu as tenu ta parole, car tu es juste.
verses.am: ልቡም በፊትህ የታመነ ሆኖ አገኘኸው፤ የከነዓናዊውንና የኬጢያዊውን የአሞራዊውንም የፌርዛዊውንም የኢያቡሳዊውንም የጌርጌሳዊውንም ምድር ለእርሱና ለዘሩ ትሰጥ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረግህ አንተም ጻድቅ ነህና ቃልህን ፈጸምህ።

verses.en: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
verses.fr: Tu vis l''affliction de nos pères en Egypte, et tu entendis leurs cris vers la mer Rouge.
verses.am: በግብጽም ሳሉ የአባታችንን መከራ አየህ፥ በኤርትራ ባሕርም ሳሉ ጩኸታቸውን ሰማህ፤

verses.en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
verses.fr: Tu opéras des miracles et des prodiges contre Pharaon, contre tous ses serviteurs et contre tout le peuple de son pays, parce que tu savais avec quelle méchanceté ils avaient traité nos pères, et tu fis paraître ta gloire comme elle paraît aujourd''hui.
verses.am: እንደ ታበዩባቸውም አውቀህ ነበርና በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ በምድሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ላይ ምልክትና ተአምራት አሳየህ፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው ስምህን አስጠራህ።

verses.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.fr: Tu fendis la mer devant eux, et ils passèrent à sec au milieu de la mer; mais tu précipitas dans l''abîme, comme une pierre au fond des eaux, ceux qui marchaient à leur poursuite.
verses.am: ከፊታቸውም ባሕሩን ከፈልህ፥ በባሕሩም መካከል በደረቅ አልፉ፤ ጠላቶቻቸውን ግን ድንጋይ ለጥልቅ ውኃ እንዲጣል በቀላይ ውስጥ ጣልሃቸው።

verses.en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.fr: Tu les guidas le jour par une colonne de nuée, et la nuit par une colonne de feu qui les éclairait dans le chemin qu''ils avaient à suivre.
verses.am: የሚሄዱበትንም መንገድ ታበራላቸው ዘንድ በቀን በደመና ዓምድ፥ በሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ መራሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
verses.fr: Tu descendis sur la montagne de Sinaï, tu leur parlas du haut des cieux, et tu leur donnas des ordonnances justes, des lois de vérité, des préceptes et des commandements excellents.
verses.am: ወደ ሲናም ተራራ ወረድህ፥ ከሰማይም ተናገርሃቸው፤ ቅኑን ፍርድና እውነቱን ሕግ መልካሙንም ሥርዓትና ትእዛዝ ሰጠሃቸው፤

verses.en: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
verses.fr: Tu leur fis connaître ton saint sabbat, et tu leur prescrivis par Moïse, ton serviteur, des commandements, des préceptes et une loi.
verses.am: የተቀደሰውንም ሰንበትህን አስታወቅሃቸው፥ ትእዛዝንና ሥርዓትን ሕግንም በባሪያህ በሙሴ እጅ አዘዝሃቸው።

verses.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
verses.fr: Tu leur donnas, du haut des cieux, du pain quand ils avaient faim, et tu fis sortir de l''eau du rocher quand ils avaient soif. Et tu leur dis d''entrer en possession du pays que tu avais juré de leur donner.
verses.am: ለራባቸውም ከሰማይ እንጀራ ሰጠሃቸው፥ ለጥማታቸውም ከዓለቱ ውኃ አመጣህላቸው፤ ወደ ማልህላቸውም ምድር ገብተው ይወርሱ ዘንድ አዘዝሃቸው።

verses.en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
verses.fr: Mais nos pères se livrèrent à l''orgueil et raidirent leur cou. Ils n''écoutèrent point tes commandements,
verses.am: ነገር ግን እነርሱና አባቶቻችን ታበዩ፥ አንገታቸውንም አደንደኑ፥ ትእዛዝህንም አልሰሙም፥

verses.en: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
verses.fr: ils refusèrent d''obéir, et ils mirent en oubli les merveilles que tu avais faites en leur faveur. Ils raidirent leur cou; et, dans leur rébellion, ils se donnèrent un chef pour retourner à leur servitude. Mais toi, tu es un Dieu prêt à pardonner, compatissant et miséricordieux, lent à la colère et riche en bonté, et tu ne les abandonnas pas,
verses.am: ለመስማትም እንቢ አሉ፥ ያደረግህላቸውንም ተአምራት አላሰቡም፤ አንገታቸውንም አደንደኑ፥ በዓመፃቸውም ወደ ባርነታቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ አለቃ አደረጉ፤ አንተ ግን ይቅር ባይ፥ ቸርና መሐሪ አምላክ፥ ለቍጣም የምትዘገይ፥ ምሕረትንም የምታበዛ ነህ፥ አልተውሃቸውም።

verses.en: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.fr: même quand ils se firent un veau en fonte et dirent: Voici ton Dieu qui t''a fait sortir d''Egypte, et qu''ils se livrèrent envers toi à de grands outrages.
verses.am: ቀልጦ የተሠራውንም እምቦሳ አድርገው። ከግብጽ ያወጣህ አምላክህ ይህ ነው ባሉ ጊዜ፥ እጅግም ባስቈጡህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.fr: Dans ton immense miséricorde, tu ne les abandonnas pas au désert, et la colonne de nuée ne cessa point de les guider le jour dans leur chemin, ni la colonne de feu de les éclairer la nuit dans le chemin qu''ils avaient à suivre.
verses.am: አንተ በምሕረትህ ብዛት በምድረ በዳ አልተውሃቸውም፤ በመንገድም ይመራቸው ዘንድ የደመና ዓምድ በቀን፥ የሚሄዱበትንም መንገድ ያበራላቸው ዘንድ የእሳት ዓምድ በሌሊት ከእነርሱ አልራቀም።

verses.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.fr: Tu leur donnas ton bon esprit pour les rendre sages, tu ne refusas point ta manne à leur bouche, et tu leur fournis de l''eau pour leur soif.
verses.am: ያስተምራቸውም ዘንድ መልካሙን መንፈስህን ሰጠሃቸው፥ መናህንም ከአፋቸው አልከለከልህም፥ ለጥማታቸውም ውኃ ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.fr: Pendant quarante ans, tu pourvus à leur entretien dans le désert, et ils ne manquèrent de rien, leurs vêtements ne s''usèrent point, et leurs pieds ne s''enflèrent point.
verses.am: አርባ ዓመትም በምድረ በዳ መገብሃቸው፥ ምንም አላጡም፤ ልብሳቸውም አላረጅም፥ እግራቸውም አላበጠም።

verses.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.fr: Tu leur livras des royaumes et des peuples, dont tu partageas entre eux les contrées, et ils possédèrent le pays de Sihon, roi de Hesbon, et le pays d''Og, roi de Basan.
verses.am: መንግሥታትንና አሕዛብን ከፍለህ ሰጠሃቸው፤ የሐሴቦንን ንጉሥ የሴዎንን ምድር፥ የባሳንንም ንጉሥ የዐግን ምድር ወረሱ።

verses.en: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
verses.fr: Tu multiplias leurs fils comme les étoiles des cieux, et tu les fis entrer dans le pays dont tu avais dit à leurs pères qu''ils prendraient possession.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውንም እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አበዛህ፤ ይገቡና ይወርሱ ዘንድ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ተናገርህላቸውም ምድር አገባሃቸው።

verses.en: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.fr: Et leurs fils entrèrent et prirent possession du pays; tu humilias devant eux les habitants du pays, les Cananéens, et tu les livras entre leurs mains, avec leurs rois et les peuples du pays, pour qu''ils les traitassent à leur gré.
verses.am: ልጆቹም ገብተው ምድሩን ወረሱ፥ የምድሩን ሰዎች ከነዓናውያንን በፊታቸው አዋረድህ፤ የሚወድዱትንም ነገር ያደረጉባቸው ዘንድ እነርሱንና ነገሥታቶቻቸውን የምድሩንም አሕዛብ በእጃቸው አሳልፈህ ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
verses.fr: Ils devinrent maîtres de villes fortifiées et de terres fertiles; ils possédèrent des maisons remplies de toutes sortes de biens, des citernes creusées, des vignes, des oliviers, et des arbres fruitiers en abondance; ils mangèrent, ils se rassasièrent, ils s''engraissèrent, et ils vécurent dans les délices par ta grande bonté.
verses.am: ምሽጎቹንም ከተሞች የሰባውንም ምድር ወሰዱ፤ መልካሙን ነገር የሞሉትን ቤቶች፥ የተማሱትንም ጕድጓዶች፥ ወይኖቹንና ወይራዎቹን ብዙዎቹንም የፍሬ ዛፎች ወረሱ፤ በሉም፥ ጠገቡም፥ ወፈሩም፥ በታላቅ በጎነትህም ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
verses.fr: Néanmoins, ils se soulevèrent et se révoltèrent contre toi. Ils jetèrent ta loi derrière leur dos, ils tuèrent tes prophètes qui les conjuraient de revenir à toi, et ils se livrèrent envers toi à de grands outrages.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንቢተኞች ነበሩ፥ ዐመፁብህም፥ ሕግህንም ወደ ኋላቸው ጣሉት፤ ወደ አንተም ይመለሱ ዘንድ የመሰከሩባቸውን ነቢያትህን ገደሉ፥ እጅግም አስቈጡህ።

verses.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
verses.fr: Alors tu les abandonnas entre les mains de leurs ennemis, qui les opprimèrent. Mais, au temps de leur détresse, ils crièrent à toi; et toi, tu les entendis du haut des cieux, et, dans ta grande miséricorde, tu leur donnas des libérateurs qui les sauvèrent de la main de leurs ennemis.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፈህ ሰጠሃቸው፥ አስጨነቁአቸውም፤ በመከራቸውም ጊዜ ወደ አንተ ጮኹ፥ ከሰማይም ሰማሃቸው፤ እንደ ምሕረትህም ብዛት ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ያዳኑአቸውን ታዳጊዎችን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the land of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
verses.fr: Quand ils eurent du repos, ils recommencèrent à faire le mal devant toi. Alors tu les abandonnas entre les mains de leurs ennemis, qui les dominèrent. Mais, de nouveau, ils crièrent à toi; et toi, tu les entendis du haut des cieux, et, dans ta grande miséricorde, tu les délivras maintes fois.
verses.am: ባረፉም ጊዜ ተመልሰው በፊትህ ክፉ አደረጉ፤ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ተውሃቸው፥ ገዙአቸውም፤ ተመልሰውም ወደ አንተ በጮኹ ጊዜ ከሰማይ ሰማሃቸው፥ እንደ ምሕረትህም ብዛት ታደግሃቸው፤

verses.en: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.fr: Tu les conjuras de revenir à ta loi; et ils persévérèrent dans l''orgueil, ils n''écoutèrent point tes commandements, ils péchèrent contre tes ordonnances, qui font vivre celui qui les met en pratique, ils eurent une épaule rebelle, ils raidirent leur cou, et ils n''obéirent point.
verses.am: ወደ ሕግህም ትመልሳቸው ዘንድ አስመሰከርህባቸው፤ ነገር ግን ታበዩ፥ ትእዛዝህንም አልሰሙም፥ ሰውም ባደረገው ጊዜ በሕይወት የሚኖርበትን ፍርድህን ተላለፉ፤ ትከሻቸውንም ሰጡ፥ አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ፥ አልሰሙምም።

verses.en: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
verses.fr: Tu les supportas de nombreuses années, tu leur donnas des avertissements par ton esprit, par tes prophètes; et ils ne prêtèrent point l''oreille. Alors tu les livras entre les mains des peuples étrangers.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ብዙ ዓመታት ታገሥሃቸው፥ በነቢያትህም እጅ በመንፈስህ መሰከርህባቸው፤ አላደመጡም፥ ስለዚህም በምድር አሕዛብ እጅ አሳልፈህ ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
verses.fr: Mais, dans ta grande miséricorde, tu ne les anéantis pas, et tu ne les abandonnas pas, car tu es un Dieu compatissant et miséricordieux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንተ ቸርና መሐሪ አምላክ ነህና በምሕረትህ ብዛት ፈጽመህ አላጠፋሃቸውም፥ አልተውሃቸውምም።

verses.en: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, ô notre Dieu, Dieu grand, puissant et redoutable, toi qui gardes ton alliance et qui exerces la miséricorde, ne regarde pas comme peu de chose toutes les souffrances que nous avons éprouvées, nous, nos rois, nos chefs, nos sacrificateurs, nos prophètes, nos pères et tout ton peuple, depuis le temps des rois d''Assyrie jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: አሁንም አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ ታላቅና ኃያል የተፈራኸውም አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከአሦር ነገሥታት ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በእኛና በነገሥታቶቻችን በአለቆቻችንም በካህናቶቻችንም በነቢያቶቻችንም በአባቶቻችንም በሕዝብህ ሁሉ ላይ የደረሰው መከራ ሁሉ በፊትህ ጥቂት መስሎ አይታይህ።

verses.en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
verses.fr: Tu as été juste dans tout ce qui nous est arrivé, car tu t''es montré fidèle, et nous avons fait le mal.
verses.am: በደረሰብንም ነገር ሁሉ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፥ አንተ እውነት አድርገሃልና፥ እኛም ኃጢአት አድርገናል።

verses.en: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
verses.fr: Nos rois, nos chefs, nos sacrificateurs et nos pères n''ont point observé ta loi, et ils n''ont été attentifs ni à tes commandements ni aux avertissements que tu leur adressais.
verses.am: ነገሥታቶቻችንም አለቆቻችንም ካህናቶቻችንም አባቶቻችንም ሕግህን አልጠበቁም፥ የመሰከርህባቸውንም ትእዛዝህንና ምስክርህን አልሰሙህም።

verses.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils étaient les maîtres, au milieu des bienfaits nombreux que tu leur accordais, dans le pays vaste et fertile que tu leur avais livré, ils ne t''ont point servi et ils ne se sont point détournés de leurs oeuvres mauvaises.
verses.am: በመንግሥታቸውም በሰጠሃቸውም ታላቅ በጎነትህ፥ በፊታቸውም በሰጠኸው በሰባው ምድር አላመለኩህም፥ ከክፉም ሥራቸው አልተመለሱም።

verses.en: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
verses.fr: Et aujourd''hui, nous voici esclaves! Nous voici esclaves sur la terre que tu as donnée à nos pères, pour qu''ils jouissent de ses fruits et de ses biens!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ዛሬ ባሪያዎች ነን፤ ፍሬዋንና በረከትዋን ይበሉ ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን በሰጠሃት ምድር፥ እነሆ፥ በእርስዋ ባሪያዎች ነን፥

verses.en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
verses.fr: Elle multiplie ses produits pour les rois auxquels tu nous as assujettis, à cause de nos péchés; ils dominent à leur gré sur nos corps et sur notre bétail, et nous sommes dans une grande angoisse!
verses.am: ስለ ኃጢአታችንም ለሾምህብን ነገሥታት በረከትዋን ታበዛለች፤ ሰውነታችንንም ይገዛሉ፥ በእንስሶቻችንም የሚወድዱትን ያደርጋሉ፥ እኛም በጽኑ መከራ ላይ ነን።

verses.en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.
verses.fr: Pour tout cela, nous contractâmes une alliance, que nous mîmes par écrit; et nos chefs, nos Lévites et nos sacrificateurs y apposèrent leur sceau.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ሁሉ የታመነውን ቃል ኪዳን አድርገን እንጽፋለን፤ አለቆቻችንም ሌዋውያኖቻችንም ካህናቶቻችንም ያትሙበታል።

verses.en: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
verses.fr: Voici ceux qui apposèrent leur sceau. Néhémie, le gouverneur, fils de Hacalia. Sédécias,
verses.am: ያተሙትም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የሐካልያ ልጅ ሐቴርሰታ ነህምያ፥

verses.en: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
verses.fr: Seraja, Azaria, Jérémie,
verses.am: ሴዴቅያስ፥ ሠራያ፥

verses.en: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,
verses.fr: Paschhur, Amaria, Malkija,
verses.am: ዓዛርያስ፥ ኤርምያስ፥ ፋስኮር፥ አማርያ፥ መልክያ፥

verses.en: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
verses.fr: Hattusch, Schebania, Malluc,
verses.am: ሐጡስ፥ ሰበንያ፥ መሉክ፥ ካሪም፥

verses.en: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
verses.fr: Harim, Merémoth, Abdias,
verses.am: ሐጡስ፥ ሰበንያ፥ መሉክ፥ ካሪም፥

verses.en: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
verses.fr: Daniel, Guinnethon, Baruc,
verses.am: ሜሪሞት፥ አብድዩ፥ ዳንኤል፥ ጌንቶን፥ ባሮክ፥

verses.en: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
verses.fr: Meschullam, Abija, Mijamin,
verses.am: ሜሱላም፥ አብያ፥ ሚያሚን፥ መዓዝያ፥ ቤልጋል፥ ሸማያ፤ እነዚህ ካህናት ነበሩ።

verses.en: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.
verses.fr: Maazia, Bilgaï, Schemaeja, sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ሜሱላም፥ አብያ፥ ሚያሚን፥ መዓዝያ፥ ቤልጋል፥ ሸማያ፤ እነዚህ ካህናት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
verses.fr: Lévites: Josué, fils d''Azania, Binnuï, des fils de Hénadad, Kadmiel,
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም፤ የአዛንያ ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ ከኤንሐዳድ ልጆች ቢንዊ፥ ቀድምኤል፤

verses.en: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
verses.fr: et leurs frères, Schebania, Hodija, Kelitha, Pelaja, Hanan,
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም ሰባንያ፥ ሆዲያ፥ ቆሊጣስ፥

verses.en: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,
verses.fr: Michée, Rehob, Haschabia,
verses.am: ፌልያ፥ ሐናን፥ ሚካ፥ ረአብ፥ ሐሸብያ፥

verses.en: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
verses.fr: Zaccur, Schérébia, Schebania,
verses.am: የሕዝቡ አለቆች፤ ፋሮስ፥ ፈሐት ሞዓብ፥

verses.en: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
verses.fr: Hodija, Bani, Beninu.
verses.am: የሕዝቡ አለቆች፤ ፋሮስ፥ ፈሐት ሞዓብ፥

verses.en: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
verses.fr: Chefs du peuple: Pareosch, Pachath-Moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
verses.am: ኤላም፥ ዛቱዕ፥ ባኒ፥ ቡኒ፥ ዓዝጋድ፥ ቤባይ፥

verses.en: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
verses.fr: Bunni, Azgad, Bébaï,
verses.am: ዓዙር፥ ሆዲያ፥ ሐሱም፥ ቤሳይ፥

verses.en: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
verses.fr: Adonija, Bigvaï, Adin,
verses.am: ዓዙር፥ ሆዲያ፥ ሐሱም፥ ቤሳይ፥

verses.en: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
verses.fr: Ather, Ezéchias, Azzur,
verses.am: ሐናን፥ ዓናያ፥ ሆሴዕ፥ ሐናንያ፥ አሱብ፥

verses.en: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
verses.fr: Hodija, Haschum, Betsaï,
verses.am: ሐናን፥ ዓናያ፥ ሆሴዕ፥ ሐናንያ፥ አሱብ፥

verses.en: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
verses.fr: Hariph, Anathoth, Nébaï,
verses.am: ሐናን፥ ዓናያ፥ ሆሴዕ፥ ሐናንያ፥ አሱብ፥

verses.en: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
verses.fr: Magpiasch, Meschullam, Hézir,
verses.am: የቀሩትም ሕዝብ፥ ካህናቱም፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹም፥ መዘምራንም፥ ናታኒምም፥ ከምድርም አሕዛብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሕግ ራሳቸውን የለዩ ሁሉ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም፥ የሚያውቁትና የሚያስተውሉትም ሁሉ ወደ ወንድሞቻቸው ወደ ታላላቆቻቸው ተጠጉ፤

verses.en: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,
verses.fr: Meschézabeel, Tsadok, Jaddua,
verses.am: የቀሩትም ሕዝብ፥ ካህናቱም፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹም፥ መዘምራንም፥ ናታኒምም፥ ከምድርም አሕዛብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሕግ ራሳቸውን የለዩ ሁሉ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም፥ የሚያውቁትና የሚያስተውሉትም ሁሉ ወደ ወንድሞቻቸው ወደ ታላላቆቻቸው ተጠጉ፤

verses.en: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
verses.fr: Pelathia, Hanan, Anaja,
verses.am: የቀሩትም ሕዝብ፥ ካህናቱም፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹም፥ መዘምራንም፥ ናታኒምም፥ ከምድርም አሕዛብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሕግ ራሳቸውን የለዩ ሁሉ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም፥ የሚያውቁትና የሚያስተውሉትም ሁሉ ወደ ወንድሞቻቸው ወደ ታላላቆቻቸው ተጠጉ፤

verses.en: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
verses.fr: Hosée, Hanania, Haschub,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ በሙሴ እጅ በተሰጠው በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ የጌታችንንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ፍርዱንም ሥርዓቱንም ይጠብቁና ያደርጉ ዘንድ እርግማንና መሐላውን አደረጉ።

verses.en: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
verses.fr: Hallochesch, Pilcha, Schobek,
verses.am: ሴቶች ልጆቻችንንም ለምድር አሕዛብ አንሰጥም፥ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ለልጆቻችን አንወስድም፤

verses.en: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
verses.fr: Rehum, Haschabna, Maaséja,
verses.am: የምድርን አሕዛብ ሸቀጥና ልዩ ልዩ እህል ሊገበዩ በሰንበት ቀን ቢያመጡ፥ በሰንበት ወይም በተቀደሰው ቀን ከእነርሱ አንገዛም፤ የሰባተኛውንም ዓመት ፍሬና ዕዳን ማስከፈል እንተዋለን ብለው ማሉ።

verses.en: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
verses.fr: Achija, Hanan, Anan,
verses.am: እኛም፥ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ሕዝቡም፥ እንደ አባቶቻችን ቤቶች በተወሰነ ጊዜ በየዓመቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት አምጥተን በሕጉ እንደ ተጻፈ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ይቃጠል ዘንድ ስለ እንጨት ቍርባን ዕጣ ተጣጣልን፤

verses.en: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
verses.fr: Malluc, Harim, Baana.
verses.am: እኛም፥ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ሕዝቡም፥ እንደ አባቶቻችን ቤቶች በተወሰነ ጊዜ በየዓመቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት አምጥተን በሕጉ እንደ ተጻፈ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ይቃጠል ዘንድ ስለ እንጨት ቍርባን ዕጣ ተጣጣልን፤

verses.en: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
verses.fr: Le reste du peuple, les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, les portiers, les chantres, les Néthiniens, et tous ceux qui s''étaient séparés des peuples étrangers pour suivre la loi de Dieu, leurs femmes, leurs fils et leurs filles, tous ceux qui étaient capables de connaissance et d''intelligence,
verses.am: በየዓመቱም የመሬታችንን በኵራት የሁሉ ዓይነት ዛፍ የፍሬ ሁሉ በኵራት ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እናመጣ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;
verses.fr: se joignirent à leurs frères les plus considérables d''entre eux. Ils promirent avec serment et jurèrent de marcher dans la loi de Dieu donnée par Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, d''observer et de mettre en pratique tous les commandements de l''Eternel, notre Seigneur, ses ordonnances et ses lois.
verses.am: በሕጉም እንደ ተጻፈ የልጆቻችንና የእንስሶቻችንን በኵራት፥ የበሬዎቻችንንና የበጎቻችንን በኵራት በአምላካችን ቤት ወደሚያገለግሉት ካህናት ወደ አምላካችን ቤት እናመጣ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, not take their daughters for our sons:
verses.fr: Nous promîmes de ne pas donner nos filles aux peuples du pays et de ne pas prendre leurs filles pour nos fils;
verses.am: የእህላችንንም በኵራት፥ የእጅ ማንሣታችንን ቍርባን፥ የዛፍ ሁሉ ፍሬ፥ ወይኑንና ዘይቱንም ወደ ካህናቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት ጓዳዎች እናመጣ ዘንድ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ከከተሞቻችን እርሻ ሁሉ አሥራት ይቀበላሉና የመሬታችንን አሥራት ወደ ሌዋውያን እናመጣ ዘንድ ማልን።

verses.en: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
verses.fr: de ne rien acheter, le jour du sabbat et les jours de fête, des peuples du pays qui apporteraient à vendre, le jour du sabbat, des marchandises ou denrées quelconques; et de faire relâche la septième année, en n''exigeant le paiement d''aucune dette.
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም አሥራቱን በተቀበሉ ጊዜ የአሮን ልጅ ካህኑ ከሌዋውያን ጋር ይሁን፤ ሌዋውያኑም የአሥራቱን አሥራት ወደ አምላካችን ቤት ወደ ጓዳዎች ወደ ዕቃ ቤት ያምጡት።

verses.en: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
verses.fr: Nous nous imposâmes aussi des ordonnances qui nous obligeaient à donner un tiers de sicle par année pour le service de la maison de notre Dieu,
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆችና የሌዊ ልጆችም የእህሉንና የወይኑን የዘይቱንም የማንሣት ቍርባንን የመቅደሱ ዕቃዎችና የሚያገለግሉት ካህናት በረኞቹና መዘምራኑ ወዳሉባቸው ጓዳዎች ያግቡት፤ እንዲሁም የአምላካችንን ቤት ከቶ አንተውም።

verses.en: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.fr: pour les pains de proposition, pour l''offrande perpétuelle, pour l''holocauste perpétuel des sabbats, des nouvelles lunes et des fêtes, pour les choses consacrées, pour les sacrifices d''expiation en faveur d''Israël, et pour tout ce qui se fait dans la maison de notre Dieu.
verses.am: ፤ ስለ አምላካችንም ቤት አገልግሎት፥ ስለ ገጸ ኅብስትም፥ ዘወትርም በሰንበትና በመባቻ ስለ ማቅረብ ስለ እህሉ ቍርባንና ስለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ስለ በዓላትም፥ ስለ ተቀደሱትም ነገሮች፥ ለእስራኤልም ስለሚያስተሰርየው ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ስለ አምላካችንም ቤት ሥራ ሁሉ በየዓመቱ የሰቅል ሢሶ እናመጣ ዘንድ ትእዛዝ በራሳችን ላይ አደረግን።

verses.en: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law:
verses.fr: Nous tirâmes au sort, sacrificateurs, Lévites et peuple, au sujet du bois qu''on devait chaque année apporter en offrande à la maison de notre Dieu, selon nos maisons paternelles, à des époques fixes, pour qu''il fût brûlé sur l''autel de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, comme il est écrit dans la loi.
verses.am: ፤ እኛም፥ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ሕዝቡም፥ እንደ አባቶቻችን ቤቶች በተወሰነ ጊዜ በየዓመቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት አምጥተን በሕጉ እንደ ተጻፈ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ይቃጠል ዘንድ ስለ እንጨት ቍርባን ዕጣ ተጣጣልን፤

verses.en: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the Lord:
verses.fr: Nous résolûmes d''apporter chaque année à la maison de l''Eternel les prémices de notre sol et les prémices de tous les fruits de tous les arbres;
verses.am: ፤ በየዓመቱም የመሬታችንን በኵራት የሁሉ ዓይነት ዛፍ የፍሬ ሁሉ በኵራት ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እናመጣ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
verses.fr: d''amener à la maison de notre Dieu, aux sacrificateurs qui font le service dans la maison de notre Dieu, les premiers-nés de nos fils et de notre bétail, comme il est écrit dans la loi, les premiers-nés de nos boeufs et de nos brebis;
verses.am: ፤ በሕጉም እንደ ተጻፈ የልጆቻችንና የእንስሶቻችንን በኵራት፥ የበሬዎቻችንንና የበጎቻችንን በኵራት በአምላካችን ቤት ወደሚያገለግሉት ካህናት ወደ አምላካችን ቤት እናመጣ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
verses.fr: d''apporter aux sacrificateurs, dans les chambres de la maison de notre Dieu, les prémices de notre pâte et nos offrandes, des fruits de tous les arbres, du moût et de l''huile; et de livrer la dîme de notre sol aux Lévites qui doivent la prendre eux-mêmes dans toutes les villes situées sur les terres que nous cultivons.
verses.am: ፤ የእህላችንንም በኵራት፥ የእጅ ማንሣታችንን ቍርባን፥ የዛፍ ሁሉ ፍሬ፥ ወይኑንና ዘይቱንም ወደ ካህናቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት ጓዳዎች እናመጣ ዘንድ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ከከተሞቻችን እርሻ ሁሉ አሥራት ይቀበላሉና የመሬታችንን አሥራት ወደ ሌዋውያን እናመጣ ዘንድ ማልን።

verses.en: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur, fils d''Aaron, sera avec les Lévites quand ils lèveront la dîme; et les Lévites apporteront la dîme de la dîme à la maison de notre Dieu, dans les chambres de la maison du trésor.
verses.am: ፤ ሌዋውያኑም አሥራቱን በተቀበሉ ጊዜ የአሮን ልጅ ካህኑ ከሌዋውያን ጋር ይሁን፤ ሌዋውያኑም የአሥራቱን አሥራት ወደ አምላካችን ቤት ወደ ጓዳዎች ወደ ዕቃ ቤት ያምጡት።

verses.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.fr: Car les enfants d''Israël et les fils de Lévi apporteront dans ces chambres les offrandes de blé, de moût et d''huile; là sont les ustensiles du sanctuaire, et se tiennent les sacrificateurs qui font le service, les portiers et les chantres. C''est ainsi que nous résolûmes de ne pas abandonner la maison de notre Dieu.
verses.am: ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆችና የሌዊ ልጆችም የእህሉንና የወይኑን የዘይቱንም የማንሣት ቍርባንን የመቅደሱ ዕቃዎችና የሚያገለግሉት ካህናት በረኞቹና መዘምራኑ ወዳሉባቸው ጓዳዎች ያግቡት፤ እንዲሁም የአምላካችንን ቤት ከቶ አንተውም።

verses.en: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
verses.fr: Les chefs du peuple s''établirent à Jérusalem. Le reste du peuple tira au sort, pour qu''un sur dix vînt habiter Jérusalem, la ville sainte, et que les autres demeurassent dans les villes.
verses.am: የሕዝቡም አለቆች በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ፤ ከቀሩትም ሕዝብ ከአሥሩ ክፍል አንዱ በቅድስቲቱ ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም፥ ዘጠኙም በሌሎች ከተሞች ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Le peuple bénit tous ceux qui consentirent volontairement à résider à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በፈቃዳቸው በኢየሩሳሌም ለመቀመጥ የወደዱትን ሰዎች ሁሉ ባረኩ።

verses.en: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
verses.fr: Voici les chefs de la province qui s''établirent à Jérusalem. Dans les villes de Juda, chacun s''établit dans sa propriété, dans sa ville, Israël, les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, les Néthiniens, et les fils des serviteurs de Salomon.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም የተቀመጡት የአገሩ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እስራኤል ግን ካህናቱም ሌዋውያኑም ናታኒምም የሰሎሞንም ባሪያዎች ልጆች እያንዳንዳቸው በየርስታቸውና በየከተማቸው በይሁዳ ከተሞች ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.fr: A Jérusalem s''établirent des fils de Juda et des fils de Benjamin. -Des fils de Juda: Athaja, fils d''Ozias, fils de Zacharie, fils d''Amaria, fils de Schephathia, fils de Mahalaleel, des fils de Pérets,
verses.am: ከይሁዳና ከብንያምም ልጆች እነዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ። ከይሁዳ ልጆች፤ ከፋሬስ ልጆች የመላልኤል ልጅ የሰፋጥያስ ልጅ የአማርያ ልጅ የዘካርያስ ልጅ የዖዝያ ልጅ አታያ፤

verses.en: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.fr: et Maaséja, fils de Baruc, fils de Col-Hozé, fils de Hazaja, fils d''Adaja, fils de Jojarib, fils de Zacharie, fils de Schiloni.
verses.am: የሴሎናዊውም ልጅ የዘካርያስ ልጅ የዮያሪብ ልጅ የዓዳያ ልጅ የዖዛያ ልጅ የኮልሖዜ ልጅ የባሮክ ልጅ መዕሤያ።

verses.en: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.fr: Total des fils de Pérets qui s''établirent à Jérusalem: quatre cent soixante-huit hommes vaillants. -
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የተቀመጡት የፋሬስ ልጆች ሁሉ አራት መቶ ስድሳ ስምንት ጽኑዓን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Benjamin: Sallu, fils de Meschullam, fils de Joëd, fils de Pedaja, fils de Kolaja, fils de Maaséja, fils d''Ithiel, fils d''Esaïe,
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የየሻያ ልጅ የኢቲኤል ልጅ የመዕሤያ ልጅ የቆላያ ልጅ የፈዳያ ልጅ የዮእድ ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ ሰሉ።

verses.en: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.fr: et, après lui, Gabbaï et Sallaï, neuf cent vingt-huit.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ጌቤና ሳላይ ዘጠኝ መቶም ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.en: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.fr: Joël, fils de Zicri, était leur chef; et Juda, fils de Senua, était le second chef de la ville.
verses.am: አለቃቸውም የዝክሪ ልጅ ኢዮኤል ነበረ፤ የሐስኑአም ልጅ ይሁዳ በከተማው ላይ ሁለተኛ ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.fr: Des sacrificateurs: Jedaeja, fils de Jojarib, Jakin,
verses.am: ከካህናቱ፤ የዮያሪብ ልጅ ዮዳኤ፥ ያኪን፥

verses.en: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
verses.fr: Seraja, fils de Hilkija, fils de Meschullam, fils de Tsadok, fils de Merajoth, fils d''Achithub, prince de la maison de Dieu,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አለቃ የአኪጦብ ልጅ የመራዮት ልጅ የሳዶቅ ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ የኪልቅያስ ልጅ ሠራያ፥

verses.en: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah.
verses.fr: et leurs frères occupés au service de la maison, huit cent vingt-deux; Adaja, fils de Jerocham, fils de Pelalia, fils d''Amtsi, fils de Zacharie, fils de Paschhur, fils de Malkija,
verses.am: የቤቱንም ሥራ የሠሩ ወንድሞቻቸው ስምንት መቶ ሀያ ሁለት፤ የመልክያ ልጅ የፋስኮር ልጅ የዘካርያስ ልጅ የአማሲ ልጅ የፈላልያ ልጅ የይሮሐም ልጅ ዓዳያ፥

verses.en: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.fr: et ses frères, chefs des maisons paternelles, deux cent quarante-deux; et Amaschsaï, fils d''Azareel, fils d''Achzaï, fils de Meschillémoth, fils d''Immer,
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም የአባቶቹ ቤቶች አለቆች ሁለት መቶ አርባ ሁለት፤ የኢሜር ልጅ የምሺሌሞት ልጅ የአሕዛይ ልጅ የኤዝርኤል ልጅ አማስያ፥

verses.en: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
verses.fr: et leurs frères, vaillants hommes, cent vingt-huit. Zabdiel, fils de Guedolim, était leur chef.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም መቶ ሀያ ስምንት ጽኑዓን ኃያላን፤ አለቃቸውም የሐግዶሊም ልጅ ዘብድኤል ነበረ።

verses.en: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.fr: Des Lévites: Schemaeja, fils de Haschub, fils d''Azrikam, fils de Haschabia, fils de Bunni,
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም፤ የቡኒ ልጅ የአሳብያ ልጅ የዓዝሪቃም ልጅ የአሱብ ልጅ ሻማያ፤

verses.en: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.fr: Schabbethaï et Jozabad, chargés des affaires extérieures de la maison de Dieu, et faisant partie des chefs des Lévites;
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በሜዳ በነበረው ሥራ ላይ የነበሩ የሌዋውያን አለቆች ሳባታይና ዮዛባት፤

verses.en: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.fr: Matthania, fils de Michée, fils de Zabdi, fils d''Asaph, le chef qui entonnait la louange à la prière, et Bakbukia, le second parmi ses frères, et Abda, fils de Schammua, fils de Galal, fils de Jeduthun.
verses.am: በጸሎትም ጊዜ ምስጋናን የሚቀነቅኑ አለቃው የአሳፍ ልጅ የዘብዲ ልጅ የሚካ ልጅ መታንያ፥ በወንድሞቹም መካከል ሁለተኛ የነበረ በቅበቃር፥ የኤዶታምም ልጅ የጋላል ልጅ የሳሙስ ልጅ አብድያ።

verses.en: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.fr: Total des Lévites dans la ville sainte: deux cent quatre-vingt-quatre.
verses.am: በቅድስቲቱ ከተማ የነበሩ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ ሁለት መቶ ሰማንያ አራት ነበሩ።

verses.en: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
verses.fr: Et les portiers: Akkub, Thalmon, et leurs frères, gardiens des portes, cent soixante-douze.
verses.am: በሮቹንም የሚጠብቁ በረኞቹ፥ ዓቁብና ጤልሞን ወንድሞቻቸውም፥ መቶ ሰባ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.fr: Le reste d''Israël, les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, s''établirent dans toutes les villes de Juda, chacun dans sa propriété.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም የቀሩት ከካህናትና ከሌዋውያንም እያንዳንዳቸው በየርስታቸው በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ውስጥ ነበሩ።

verses.en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
verses.fr: Les Néthiniens s''établirent sur la colline, et ils avaient pour chefs Tsicha et Guischpa.
verses.am: ናታኒምም በዖፌል ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ሲሐና ጊሽጳ በናታኒም ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
verses.fr: Le chef des Lévites à Jérusalem était Uzzi, fils de Bani, fils de Haschabia, fils de Matthania, fils de Michée, d''entre les fils d''Asaph, les chantres chargés des offices de la maison de Dieu;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ሥራ ላይ ከነበሩ መዘምራን ከአሳፍ ልጆች ወገን የሚካ ልጅ የመታንያ ልጅ የሐሸብያ ልጅ የባኒ ልጅ ኦዚ በኢየሩሳሌም የሌዋውያን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.fr: car il y avait un ordre du roi concernant les chantres, et un salaire fixe leur était accordé pour chaque jour.
verses.am: ስለ እነርሱም የንጉሥ ትእዛዝ ነበረ፤ የመዘምራኑም ሥርዓት ለየዕለቱ የተሠራ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.fr: Pethachja, fils de Meschézabeel, des fils de Zérach, fils de Juda, était commissaire du roi pour toutes les affaires du peuple.
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ልጅ ከዛራ ወገን የሜሴዜቤል ልጅ ፈታያ ስለ ሕዝቡ ነገር ሁሉ በንጉሡ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
verses.fr: Dans les villages et leurs territoires, des fils de Juda s''établirent à Kirjath-Arba et dans les lieux de son ressort, à Dibon et dans les lieux de son ressort, à Jekabtseel et dans les villages de son ressort,
verses.am: ስለ መንደሮቹና ስለ እርሾቻቸው፤ ከይሁዳ ልጆች አያሌዎች በቂርያትአርባቅና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በዲቦንና በመንደሮችዋም፥ በይቀብጽኤልና በመንደሮችዋም፥

verses.en: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,
verses.fr: Jéschua, à Molada, à Beth-Paleth,
verses.am: በቤርሳቤህና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በጺቅላግ፥

verses.en: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,
verses.fr: Hatsar-Schual, à Beer-Schéba, et dans les lieux de son ressort,
verses.am: በቤርሳቤህና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በጺቅላግ፥

verses.en: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
verses.fr: Tsiklag, à Mecona et dans les lieux de son ressort,
verses.am: በምኮናና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በዓይንሪሞን፥

verses.en: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
verses.fr: En-Rimmon, à Tsorea, à Jarmuth,
verses.am: በጾርዓ፥ በየርሙት፥ በዛኖዋ በዓዶላም በመንደሮቻቸውም፥ በለኪሶና በእርሻዎችዋ፥ በዓዜቃና በመንደሮችዋ ተቀመጡ። እንዲሁ ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ሄኖም ሸለቆ ድረስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.fr: Zanoach, à Adullam, et dans les villages de leur ressort, à Lakis et dans son territoire, à Azéka et dans les lieux de son ressort. Ils s''établirent depuis Beer-Schéba jusqu''à la vallée de Hinnom.
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች ከጌባ ጀምሮ በማክማስ፥ በጋያ፥

verses.en: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages.
verses.fr: Les fils de Benjamin s''établirent, depuis Guéba, à Micmasch, à Ajja, à Béthel et dans les lieux de son ressort,
verses.am: በቤቴልና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በዓናቶት፥ በኖብ፥

verses.en: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.fr: Anathoth, à Nob, à Hanania,
verses.am: በስቦይም፥ በንበላት፥ በሎድ፥ በኦኖ፥ በጌሐራሺም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.fr: Hatsor, à Rama, à Guitthaïm,
verses.am: በስቦይም፥ በንበላት፥ በሎድ፥ በኦኖ፥ በጌሐራሺም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.fr: Hadid, à Tseboïm, à Neballath,
verses.am: በይሁዳም ከነበሩ ሌዋውያን አያሌ ክፍሎች ወደ ብንያም ሆኑ።

verses.en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.fr: Lod et à Ono, la vallée des ouvriers.
verses.am: ፤ በስቦይም፥ በንበላት፥ በሎድ፥ በኦኖ፥ በጌሐራሺም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
verses.fr: Il y eut des Lévites qui se joignirent à Benjamin, quoique appartenant aux divisions de Juda.
verses.am: ፤ በይሁዳም ከነበሩ ሌዋውያን አያሌ ክፍሎች ወደ ብንያም ሆኑ።

verses.en: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
verses.fr: Voici les sacrificateurs et les Lévites qui revinrent avec Zorobabel, fils de Schealthiel, et avec Josué: Seraja, Jérémie, Esdras,
verses.am: ከሰላትያል ልጅ ከዘሩባቤልና ከኢያሱ ጋር የወጡት ካህናትና ሌዋውያን እነዚህ ነበሩ፤

verses.en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
verses.fr: Amaria, Malluc, Hattusch,
verses.am: ሠራያ፥ ኤርምያስ፥ ዕዝራ፥ አማርያ፥

verses.en: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
verses.fr: Schecania, Rehum, Merémoth,
verses.am: መሉክ፥ ሐጡስ፥ ሴኬንያ፥ ሬሁም፥ ሜሪሞት፥

verses.en: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
verses.fr: Iddo, Guinnethoï, Abija,
verses.am: አዶ፥ ጌንቶን፥ አብያ፥ ሚያሚን

verses.en: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.fr: Mijamin, Maadia, Bilga,
verses.am: አዶ፥ ጌንቶን፥ አብያ፥ ሚያሚን

verses.en: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
verses.fr: Schemaeja, Jojarib, Jedaeja,
verses.am: መዓድያ፥ ቢልጋ፥ ሸማያ፥ ዮያሪብ፥ ዮዳኤ፥

verses.en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
verses.fr: Sallu, Amok, Hilkija, Jedaeja. Ce furent là les chefs des sacrificateurs et de leurs frères, au temps de Josué. -
verses.am: ሰሉ፥ ዓሞቅ፥ ኬልቅያስ፥ ዮዳኤ፤ እነዚህ በኢያሱ ዘመን የካህናቱና የወንድሞቻቸው አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
verses.fr: Lévites: Josué, Binnuï, Kadmiel, Schérébia, Juda, Matthania, qui dirigeait avec ses frères le chant des louanges;
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም፤ ኢያሱ፥ ቢንዊ፥ ቀድምኤል፥ ሰራብያ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ከወንድሞቹም ጋር በመዘምራን ላይ የነበረ መታንያ።

verses.en: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
verses.fr: Bakbukia et Unni, qui remplissaient leurs fonctions auprès de leurs frères.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም በቅቡቅያና ዑኒ በየሰሞናቸው በአንጻራቸው ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
verses.fr: Josué engendra Jojakim, Jojakim engendra Eliaschib, Eliaschib engendra Jojada,
verses.am: ኢያሱም ዮአቂምን ወለደ፥ ዮአቂምም ኤልያሴብን ወለደ፥ ኤልያሴብም ዮአዳን ወለደ፥

verses.en: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
verses.fr: Jojada engendra Jonathan, et Jonathan engendra Jaddua.
verses.am: ዮአዳም ዮናታንን ወለደ፥ ዮናታንም ያዱአን ወለደ።

verses.en: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.fr: Voici, au temps de Jojakim, quels étaient les sacrificateurs, chefs de famille: pour Seraja, Meraja; pour Jérémie, Hanania;
verses.am: በዮአቂምም ዘመን የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች እነዚህ ካህናቱ ነበሩ፤ ከሠራያ ምራያ፥

verses.en: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.fr: pour Esdras, Meschullam; pour Amaria, Jochanan;
verses.am: ከኤርምያስ ሐናንያ፥ ከዕዝራ ሜሱላም፥

verses.en: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
verses.fr: pour Meluki, Jonathan; pour Schebania, Joseph;
verses.am: ከአማርያ ይሆሐናን፥ ከመሉኪ ዮናታን፥

verses.en: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.fr: pour Harim, Adna; pour Merajoth, Helkaï;
verses.am: ከሰበንያ ዮሴፍ፥ ከካሪም ዓድና፥ ከመራዮት ሔልቃይ፥

verses.en: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.fr: pour Iddo, Zacharie; pour Guinnethon, Meschullam;
verses.am: ከአዶ ዘካርያስ፥ ከጌንቶን ሜሱላም፥

verses.en: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai:
verses.fr: pour Abija, Zicri; pour Minjamin et Moadia, Pilthaï;
verses.am: ከአብያ ዚክሪ፥ ከሚያሚን ሞዓድያ፥

verses.en: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.fr: pour Bilga, Schammua; pour Schemaeja, Jonathan;
verses.am: ፈልጣይ፥ ከቢልጋ ሳሙስ፥ ከሸማያ ዮናታን፥

verses.en: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.fr: pour Jojarib, Matthnaï; pour Jedaeja, Uzzi;
verses.am: ከዮያሪብ መትናይ፥ ከዮዳኤ ኦዚ፥

verses.en: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.fr: pour Sallaï, Kallaï; pour Amok, Eber;
verses.am: ከሳላይ ቃላይ፥ ከዓሞቅ ዔቤር፥

verses.en: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
verses.fr: pour Hilkija, Haschabia; pour Jedaeja, Nethaneel.
verses.am: ከኬልቅያስ ሐሸብያ፥ ከዮዳኤ ናትናኤል።

verses.en: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.fr: Au temps d''Eliaschib, de Jojada, de Jochanan et de Jaddua, les Lévites, chefs de familles, et les sacrificateurs, furent inscrits, sous le règne de Darius, le Perse.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያኑም በኤልያሴብና በዮአዳ፥ በዮሐናንና በያዱአ ዘመን የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ተጻፉ፤ ካህናቱም በፋርሳዊው በዳርዮስ መንግሥት ዘመን ተጻፉ።

verses.en: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.fr: Les fils de Lévi, chefs de familles, furent inscrits dans le livre des Chroniques jusqu''au temps de Jochanan, fils d''Eliaschib.
verses.am: የሌዊ ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች እስከ ኤልያሴብ ልጅ እስከ ዮሐናን ዘመን ድረስ በታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጻፉ።

verses.en: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
verses.fr: Les chefs des Lévites, Haschabia, Schérébia, et Josué, fils de Kadmiel, et leurs frères avec eux, les uns vis-à-vis des autres, étaient chargés de célébrer et de louer l''Eternel, selon l''ordre de David, homme de Dieu.
verses.am: የሌዋውያኑም አለቆች፤ ሐሸብያ፥ ሰራብያ፥ የቀድምኤልም ልጅ ኢያሱ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ዳዊት ትእዛዝ በየሰሞናቸው በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ያከብሩና ያመሰግኑ ነበር።

verses.en: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
verses.fr: Matthania, Bakbukia, Abdias, Meschullam, Thalmon et Akkub, portiers, faisaient la garde aux seuils des portes.
verses.am: መታንያ፥ በቅቡቅያ፥ አብድዮ፥ ሜሱላም፥ ጤልሞን፥ ዓቁብ በበሮች አጠገብ የሚገኙትን ዕቃ ቤቶች ለመጠበቅ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
verses.fr: Ils vivaient au temps de Jojakim, fils de Josué, fils de Jotsadak, et au temps de Néhémie, le gouverneur, et d''Esdras, le sacrificateur et le scribe.
verses.am: እነዚህ በኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ በኢያሱ ልጅ በዮአቂም በአለቃውም በነህምያ በጸሐፊውም በካህኑ በዕዝራ ዘመን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.fr: Lors de la dédicace des murailles de Jérusalem, on appela les Lévites de tous les lieux qu''ils habitaient et on les fit venir à Jérusalem, afin de célébrer la dédicace et la fête par des louanges et par des chants, au son des cymbales, des luths et des harpes.
verses.am: የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር በቀደሱ ጊዜ ቅዳሴውን በደስታና በምስጋና በመዝሙርም በጸናጽልም በበገናም በመሰንቆም ለማድረግ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡአቸው ዘንድ ሌዋውያኑን በየስፍራቸው ሁሉ ፈለጉ።

verses.en: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
verses.fr: Les fils des chantres se rassemblèrent des environs de Jérusalem, des villages des Nethophatiens,
verses.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም ራሳቸውን አነጹ፤ ሕዝቡንም በሮቹንም ቅጥሩንም አነጹ።

verses.en: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.fr: de Beth-Guilgal, et du territoire de Guéba et d''Azmaveth; car les chantres s''étaient bâti des villages aux alentours de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም ራሳቸውን አነጹ፤ ሕዝቡንም በሮቹንም ቅጥሩንም አነጹ።

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs et les Lévites se purifièrent, et ils purifièrent le peuple, les portes et la muraille.
verses.am: የይሁዳንም አለቆች ወደ ቅጥሩ ላይ አወጣኋቸው፤ አመስጋኞቹንም በሁለት ታላላቅ ተርታ አቆምኋቸው፤ አንዱም ወደ ቀኝ በቅጥሩ ላይ ወደ ጕድፍ መጣያው በር ሄደ።

verses.en: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
verses.fr: Je fis monter sur la muraille les chefs de Juda, et je formai deux grands choeurs. Le premier se mit en marche du côté droit sur la muraille, vers la porte du fumier.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ ሆሻያ፥ የይሁዳም አለቆች እኵሌታ፥

verses.en: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
verses.fr: Derrière ce choeur marchaient Hosée et la moitié des chefs de Juda,
verses.am: ዓዛርያስ፥ ዕዝራ፥

verses.en: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.fr: Azaria, Esdras, Meschullam,
verses.am: ሜሱላም፥ ይሁዳ፥ ብንያም፥ ሸማያ፥ ኤርምያስ፥

verses.en: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.fr: Juda, Benjamin, Schemaeja et Jérémie,
verses.am: መለከትም ይዘው ከካህናቱ ልጆች አያሌዎች፥ የአሳፍም ልጅ የዘኩር ልጅ የሚካያ ልጅ የመታንያ ልጅ የሸማያ ልጅ የዮናታን ልጅ ዘካርያስ፥

verses.en: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
verses.fr: des fils de sacrificateurs avec des trompettes, Zacharie, fils de Jonathan, fils de Schemaeja, fils de Matthania, fils de Michée, fils de Zaccur, fils d''Asaph,
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም ሸማያ፥ ኤዝርኤል፥ ሚላላይ፥ ጊላላይ፥ መዓይ፥ ናትናኤል፥ ይሁዳ፥ አናኒ የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው የዳዊትን የዜማውን ዕቃ ይዘው ሄዱ፤ ጸሐፊውም ዕዝራ በፊታቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
verses.fr: et ses frères, Schemaeja, Azareel, Milalaï, Guilalaï, Maaï, Nethaneel, Juda et Hanani, avec les instruments de musique de David, homme de Dieu. Esdras, le scribe, était à leur tête.
verses.am: በምንጭም በር አቅንተው ሄዱ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ደረጃ፥ በቅጥሩም መውጫ፥ ከዳዊትም ቤት በላይ እስከ ውኃው በር ድረስ በምሥራቅ በኩል ሄዱ።

verses.en: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.fr: A la porte de la source, ils montèrent vis-à-vis d''eux les degrés de la cité de David par la montée de la muraille, au-dessus de la maison de David, jusqu''à la porte des eaux, vers l''orient.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም የአመስጋኞቹ ተርታ ወደ ግራ ሄደ፤ እኔና የሕዝቡም እኵሌታ በስተኋላቸው ነበርን፤ በቅጥሩም ላይ፥ በእቶኑ ግንብ በላይ እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ፥ ከኤፍሬምም በር በላይ፥

verses.en: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
verses.fr: Le second choeur se mit en marche à l''opposite. J''étais derrière lui avec l''autre moitié du peuple, sur la muraille. Passant au-dessus de la tour des fours, on alla jusqu''à la muraille large;
verses.am: በአሮጌው በርና በዓሣ በር በሐናንኤልም ግንብ፥ በሃሜአ ግንብ እስከ በጎች በር ድረስ ሄዱ፤ በዘበኞችም በር አጠገብ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
verses.fr: puis au-dessus de la porte d''Ephraïm, de la vieille porte, de la porte des poissons, de la tour de Hananeel et de la tour de Méa, jusqu''à la porte des brebis. Et l''on s''arrêta à la porte de la prison.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ሁለቱ የአመስጋኞች ተርታዎች በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ቆሙ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር እኔና የአለቆች እኵሌታ፥

verses.en: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
verses.fr: Les deux choeurs s''arrêtèrent dans la maison de Dieu; et nous fîmes de même, moi et les magistrats qui étaient avec moi,
verses.am: ካህናቱም ኤልያቄም፥ መዕሤያ፥ ሚንያሚን፥ ሚካያ፥ ኤልዮዔናይ፥

verses.en: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.fr: et les sacrificateurs Eliakim, Maaséja, Minjamin, Michée, Eljoénaï, Zacharie, Hanania, avec des trompettes,
verses.am: ዘካርያስ፥ ሐናንያ መለከት ይዘው፥ መዕሤያ፥ ሸማያ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኦዚ፥ ይሆሐናን፥ መልክያ፥ ኤላም፥ ኤጽር ቆምን። መዘምራኑም በታላቅ ድምፅ ዘመሩ፥ አለቃቸውም ይዝረሕያ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.fr: et Maaséja, Schemaeja, Eléazar, Uzzi, Jochanan, Malkija, Elam et Ezer. Les chantres se firent entendre, dirigés par Jizrachja.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ደስታ ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና በዚያ ቀን ትልቅ መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ፥ ደስም አላቸው፤ ሴቶቹና ልጆቹም ደግሞ ደስ አላቸው፤ የኢየሩሳሌምም ደስታ ከሩቅ ተሰማ።

verses.en: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.fr: On offrit ce jour-là de nombreux sacrifices, et on se livra aux réjouissances, car Dieu avait donné au peuple un grand sujet de joie. Les femmes et les enfants se réjouirent aussi, et les cris de joie de Jérusalem furent entendus au loin.
verses.am: ይሁዳም በአገልጋዮቹ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን ደስ ስላላቸው፥ የካህናቱንና የሌዋውያኑን እድል ፈንታ እንደ ሕጉ ከከተሞች እርሻዎች ያከማቹ ዘንድ ለእጅ ማንሣት ቍርባንና ለበኵራት ለአሥራትም በየዕቃ ቤቶቹ ላይ በዚያ ቀን ሰዎች ተሾሙ።

verses.en: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
verses.fr: En ce jour, on établit des hommes ayant la surveillance des chambres qui servaient de magasins pour les offrandes, les prémices et les dîmes, et on les chargea d''y recueillir du territoire des villes les portions assignées par la loi aux sacrificateurs et aux Lévites. Car Juda se réjouissait de ce que les sacrificateurs et les Lévites étaient à leur poste,
verses.am: እነርሱም መዘምራኑና በረኞቹም የአምላካቸውን ሥርዓት የመንጻታቸውንም ሥርዓት እንደ ዳዊትና እንደ ልጁ እንደ ሰሎሞን ትእዛዝ ጠበቁ።

verses.en: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.fr: observant tout ce qui concernait le service de Dieu et des purifications. Les chantres et les portiers remplissaient aussi leurs fonctions, selon l''ordre de David et de Salomon, son fils;
verses.am: አስቀድሞም በዳዊትና በአሳፍ ዘመን እግዚአብሔርን በዜማ ለማመስገንና ለማክበር የመዘምራን አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.fr: car autrefois, du temps de David et d''Asaph, il y avait des chefs de chantres et des chants de louanges et d''actions de grâces en l''honneur de Dieu.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በዘሩባቤልና በነህምያ ዘመን ለመዘምራኑና ለበረኞቹ እድል ፈንታቸውን በየዕለቱ ይሰጡ ነበር፤ የተቀደሰውንም ነገር ለሌዋውያን ሰጡ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ከተቀደሰው ነገር ለአሮን ልጆች ሰጡ።

verses.en: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
verses.fr: Tout Israël, au temps de Zorobabel et de Néhémie, donna les portions des chantres et des portiers, jour par jour; on donna aux Lévites les choses consacrées, et les Lévites donnèrent aux fils d''Aaron les choses consacrées.
verses.am: ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በዘሩባቤልና በነህምያ ዘመን ለመዘምራኑና ለበረኞቹ እድል ፈንታቸውን በየዕለቱ ይሰጡ ነበር፤ የተቀደሰውንም ነገር ለሌዋውያን ሰጡ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ከተቀደሰው ነገር ለአሮን ልጆች ሰጡ።

verses.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
verses.fr: Dans ce temps, on lut en présence du peuple dans le livre de Moïse, et l''on y trouva écrit que l''Ammonite et le Moabite ne devraient jamais entrer dans l''assemblée de Dieu,
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የሙሴን መጽሐፍ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ አነበቡ፤ አሞናውያንና ሞዓባውያንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ ለዘላለም እንዳይገቡ የሚል በዚያ ተገኘ።

verses.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.fr: parce qu''ils n''étaient pas venus au-devant des enfants d''Israël avec du pain et de l''eau, et parce qu''ils avaient appelé contre eux à prix d''argent Balaam pour qu''il les maudît; mais notre Dieu changea la malédiction en bénédiction.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች በእንጀራና በውኃ ስላልተቀበሉአቸውና ይረግማቸው ዘንድ በለዓምን ስለ ገዙባቸው ነው፤ ነገር ግን አምላካችን እርግማኑን ወደ በረከት መለሰው።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on eut entendu la loi, on sépara d''Israël tous les étrangers.
verses.am: ሕጉንም በሰሙ ጊዜ ድብልቁን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ለዩ።

verses.en: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:
verses.fr: Avant cela, le sacrificateur Eliaschib, établi dans les chambres de la maison de notre Dieu, et parent de Tobija,
verses.am: ከዚህም አስቀድሞ በአምላካችን ቤት ጓዳዎች ላይ ተሾሞ የነበረው ካህኑ ኤልያሴብ ከጦቢያ ጋር ተወዳጅቶ፥

verses.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
verses.fr: avait disposé pour lui une grande chambre où l''on mettait auparavant les offrandes, l''encens, les ustensiles, la dîme du blé, du moût et de l''huile, ce qui était ordonné pour les Lévites, les chantres et les portiers, et ce qui était prélevé pour les sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያን፥ ለመዘምራን፥ ለበረኞቹ እንደ ሕጉ የተሰጣቸውን የእህሉን ቍርባንና ዕጣኑን፥ ዕቃዎቹንም፥ የእህሉንና የወይኑን የዘይቱንም አሥራት፥ ለካህናቱም የሆነውን የማንሣት ቍርባን አስቀድሞ ያስቀመጡበትን ታላቁን ጓዳ አዘጋጅቶለት ነበር።

verses.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
verses.fr: Je n''étais point à Jérusalem quand tout cela eut lieu, car j''étais retourné auprès du roi la trente-deuxième année d''Artaxerxès, roi de Babylone. A la fin de l''année, j''obtins du roi la permission
verses.am: እኔ ግን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በአርጤክስስ በሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ወደ ንጉሡ ሄጄ ነበርና በዚህ ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም አልነበርሁም። ከጥቂት ዘመንም በኋላ የንጉሡን ፈቃድ ለመንሁ፤

verses.en: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.fr: de revenir à Jérusalem, et je m''aperçus du mal qu''avait fait Eliaschib, en disposant une chambre pour Tobija dans les parvis de la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣሁ፤ ኤልያሴብም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ለጦብያ ጓዳውን በማዘጋጀት ያደረገውን ክፉ ነገር አስተዋልሁ።

verses.en: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff to Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.fr: J''en éprouvai un vif déplaisir, et je jetai hors de la chambre tous les objets qui appartenaient à Tobija;
verses.am: እጅግም አስከፋኝ፤ የጦብያንም የቤቱን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከጓዳ ወደ ውጪ ጣልሁ።

verses.en: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
verses.fr: j''ordonnai qu''on purifiât les chambres, et j''y replaçai les ustensiles de la maison de Dieu, les offrandes et l''encens.
verses.am: ጓዳዎቹንም እንዲያነጹ አዘዝሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ዕቃዎች የእህሉንም ቍርባን ዕጣኑንም መልሼ በዚያ አገባሁ።

verses.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
verses.fr: J''appris aussi que les portions des Lévites n''avaient point été livrées, et que les Lévites et les chantres chargés du service s''étaient enfuis chacun dans son territoire.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም እድል ፈንታቸው እንዳልተሰጠ፥ የሚያገለግሉትም ሌዋውያንና መዘምራን እያንዳንዱ ወደ እርሻው እንደ ሄዱ ተመለከትሁ።

verses.en: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.fr: Je fis des réprimandes aux magistrats, et je dis: Pourquoi la maison de Dieu a-t-elle été abandonnée? Et je rassemblai les Lévites et les chantres, et je les remis à leur poste.
verses.am: እኔም። የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስለ ምን ተተወ? ብዬ ከአለቆቹ ጋር ተከራከርሁ። ሰበሰብኋቸውም፥ በየስፍራቸውም አቆምኋቸው።

verses.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
verses.fr: Alors tout Juda apporta dans les magasins la dîme du blé, du moût et de l''huile.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ሁሉ የእህሉንና የወይኑን የዘይቱንም አሥራት ወደ ዕቃ ቤቶች አመጡ።

verses.en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
verses.fr: Je confiai la surveillance des magasins à Schélémia, le sacrificateur, à Tsadok, le scribe, et à Pedaja, l''un des Lévites, et je leur adjoignis Hanan, fils de Zaccur, fils de Matthania, car ils avaient la réputation d''être fidèles. Ils furent chargés de faire les distributions à leurs frères.
verses.am: በዕቃ ቤቶችም ላይ ካህኑን ሰሌምያን፥ ጸሐፊውንም ሳዶቅን፥ ከሌዋውያኑም ፈዳያን ሾምሁ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር የመታንያ ልጅ የዘኩር ልጅ ሐናን ነበረ፤ እነርሱም የታመኑ ሆነው ተገኙ፥ ሥራቸውም ለወንድሞቻቸው ማከፋፈል ነበረ።

verses.en: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de moi, ô mon Dieu, à cause de cela, et n''oublie pas mes actes de piété à l''égard de la maison de mon Dieu et des choses qui doivent être observées!
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ አስበኝ፤ ለአምላኬም ቤት ያደረግሁትን ወረታዬን አታጥፋ።

verses.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
verses.fr: A cette époque, je vis en Juda des hommes fouler au pressoir pendant le sabbat, rentrer des gerbes, charger sur des ânes même du vin, des raisins et des figues, et toutes sortes de choses, et les amener à Jérusalem le jour du sabbat; et je leur donnai des avertissements le jour où ils vendaient leurs denrées.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት በይሁዳ በሰንበት ቀን የወይን መጥመቂያን የሚረግጡትን፥ ነዶም የሚከመሩትን፥ የወይኑን ጠጅና የወይኑን ዘለላ በለሱንም ልዩ ልዩም ዓይነት ሸክም በአህዮች ላይ የሚጭኑትን፥ በሰንበትም ቀን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም የሚያስገቡትን አየሁ፤ ገበያ ባደረጉበትም ቀን አስመሰከርሁባቸው።

verses.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il y avait aussi des Tyriens, établis à Jérusalem, qui apportaient du poisson et toutes sortes de marchandises, et qui les vendaient aux fils de Juda le jour du sabbat et dans Jérusalem.
verses.am: ደግሞም በእርስዋ የተቀመጡ የጢሮስ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም ዓሣዎችን ልዩ ልዩም ዓይነት ሸቀጥ አምጥተው በሰንበት ቀን በኢየሩሳሌም ለይሁዳ ልጆች ይሸጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
verses.fr: Je fis des réprimandes aux grands de Juda, et je leur dis: Que signifie cette mauvaise action que vous faites, en profanant le jour du sabbat?
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ታላላቆች ጋር ተከራከርሁና። ይህ የምታደርጉት ክፉ ነገር ምንድር ነው? የሰንበትንስ ቀን ታረክሳላችሁን?

verses.en: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas ainsi qu''ont agi vos pères, et n''est-ce pas à cause de cela que notre Dieu a fait venir tous ces malheurs sur nous et sur cette ville? Et vous, vous attirez de nouveau sa colère contre Israël, en profanant le sabbat!
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁ እንደዚህ አድርገው አልነበረምን? አምላካችንስ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በእኛና በዚህ ከተማ ላይ አምጥቶ አልነበረምን? እናንተም ሰንበትን በማርከሳችሁ በእስራኤል ላይ መዓትን ትጨምራላችሁ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
verses.fr: Puis j''ordonnai qu''on fermât les portes de Jérusalem avant le sabbat, dès qu''elles seraient dans l''ombre, et qu''on ne les ouvrît qu''après le sabbat. Et je plaçai quelques-uns de mes serviteurs aux portes, pour empêcher l''entrée des fardeaux le jour du sabbat.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ከሰንበት በፊት በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች ድንግዝግዝታ በሆነ ጊዜ በሮችዋ እንዲዘጉ፥ ሰንበትም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ እንዳይከፈቱ አዘዝሁ። በሰንበትም ቀን ሸክም እንዳይገባ ከብላቴኖቼ በአያሌዎቹ በሮችዋን አስጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.fr: Alors les marchands et les vendeurs de toutes sortes de choses passèrent une ou deux fois la nuit hors de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሁሉም አንድ ወይም ሁለት ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም ውጭ አድረው ገበያ አድርገው ነበር።

verses.en: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
verses.fr: Je les avertis, en leur disant: Pourquoi passez-vous la nuit devant la muraille? Si vous le faites encore, je mettrai la main sur vous. Dès ce moment, ils ne vinrent plus pendant le sabbat.
verses.am: እኔም አስመሰከርሁባቸውና። በቅጥሩ ውጭ ለምን ታድራላችሁ? እንደ ገና ብታደርጉት እጆቼን አነሣባችኋለሁ አልኋቸው። ከዚያም ወዲያ በሰንበት ቀን እንደ ገና አልመጡም።

verses.en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
verses.fr: J''ordonnai aussi aux Lévites de se purifier et de venir garder les portes pour sanctifier le jour du sabbat. Souviens-toi de moi, ô mon Dieu, à cause de cela, et protège-moi selon ta grande miséricorde!
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑንም ራሳቸውን እንዲያነጹ፥ መጥተውም በሮቹን እንዲጠብቁ፥ የሰንበትንም ቀን እንዲቀድሱ ነገርኋቸው። አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ደግሞ አስበኝ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህም ብዛት ራራልኝ።

verses.en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:
verses.fr: A cette même époque, je vis des Juifs qui avaient pris des femmes asdodiennes, ammonites, moabites.
verses.am: ደግሞም በዚያ ወራት የአዛጦንና የአሞንን የሞዓብንም ሴቶች ያገቡትን አይሁድ አየሁ።

verses.en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.
verses.fr: La moitié de leurs fils parlaient l''asdodien, et ne savaient pas parler le juif; ils ne connaissaient que la langue de tel ou tel peuple.
verses.am: ከልጆቻቸውም እኵሌቶቹ በአዛጦን ቋንቋ ይናገሩ ነበር፥ በአይሁድም ቋንቋ መናገር አያውቁም ነበር።

verses.en: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
verses.fr: Je leur fis des réprimandes, et je les maudis; j''en frappai quelques-uns, je leur arrachai les cheveux, et je les fis jurer au nom de Dieu, en disant: Vous ne donnerez pas vos filles à leurs fils, et vous ne prendrez leurs filles ni pour vos fils ni pour vous.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ተከራከርሁ፥ ረገምኋቸውም፤ ከእነርሱም አያሌዎቹን መታሁ፥ ጠጉራቸውንም ነጨሁ፥ እንዲህም ብዬ በእግዚአብሔር አማልኋቸው። ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ለወንዶች ልጆቻቸው አትስጡ፥ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ለእናንተና ለልጆቻችሁ አትውሰዱ።

verses.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas en cela qu''a péché Salomon, roi d''Israël? Il n''y avait point de roi semblable à lui parmi la multitude des nations, il était aimé de son Dieu, et Dieu l''avait établi roi sur tout Israël; néanmoins, les femmes étrangères l''entraînèrent aussi dans le péché.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን በዚህ ነገር ኃጢአት አድርጎ የለምን? በብዙ አሕዛብም መካከል እንደ እርሱ ያለ ንጉሥ አልነበረም፥ በአምላኩም ዘንድ የተወደደ ነበረ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አንግሦት ነበር፤ እርሱንም እንኳ እንግዶች ሴቶች አሳቱት።

verses.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
verses.fr: Faut-il donc apprendre à votre sujet que vous commettez un aussi grand crime et que vous péchez contre notre Dieu en prenant des femmes étrangères?
verses.am: በውኑ ይህን ሁሉ ታላቅ ክፋት እንሠራ፥ እንግዶችንም ሴቶች በማግባት አምላካችን እንበድል ዘንድ እናንተን እንስማ?

verses.en: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
verses.fr: Un des fils de Jojada, fils d''Eliaschib, le souverain sacrificateur, était gendre de Sanballat, le Horonite. Je le chassai loin de moi.
verses.am: ከዋነኛውም ካህን ከኤልያሴብ ልጅ ከዮአዳ ልጆች አንዱ ለሖሮናዊው ለሰንባላጥ አማች ነበረ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ አባረርሁት።

verses.en: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi d''eux, ô mon Dieu, car ils ont souillé le sacerdoce et l''alliance contractée par les sacrificateurs et les Lévites.
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ክህነትን የክህነትንና የሌዋውያንንም ቃል ኪዳን ስላፈረሱ አስባቸው።

verses.en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;
verses.fr: Je les purifiai de tout étranger, et je remis en vigueur ce que devaient observer les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, chacun dans sa fonction,
verses.am: ከእንግዳ ነገርም ሁሉ አነጻኋቸው፤ ለካህናቱና ለሌዋውያኑም እያንዳንዳቸው በየሰሞናቸው፥

verses.en: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
verses.fr: et ce qui concernait l''offrande du bois aux époques fixées, de même que les prémices. Souviens-toi favorablement de moi, ô mon Dieu!
verses.am: በየጊዜያቸውም ለእንጨት ቍርባን ለበኵራቱም ሥርዓት አደረግሁ። አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በመልካም አስበኝ።
